line: You told a nice story, Colonel... but how can we know that it happened the way you described?

speaker: SCHOONOVER
line: Well, perhaps I wasn't clear. I was there, ma'am. That officer that didn't listen to Frank, got his men trapped... you're looking at him. And believe me when I tell you, I thank God every day that I only lost my arm. That man saved my life, the lives of his entire team. If it was up to me, he'd have a Medal of Honor hanging around his neck.

speaker: REYES
line: No further questions at this time, Your Honor.

speaker: TOWER
line: How'd you miss that in his file?

speaker: REYES
line: All the names were redacted.

speaker: TOWER
line: Not good.

speaker: REYES
line: No shit.

speaker: FOGGY
line: Hey, Matt couldn't have done it better. It was good.

speaker: MATT
line: How is she?

speaker: STICK
line: Well... she'll live.

speaker: MATT
line: Yeah? You sure?

speaker: STICK
line: Sure as I am of anything. Jesus, didn't we do this already?

speaker: MATT
line: Start talking, Stick.

speaker: STICK
line: It's about the war.

speaker: MATT
line: What is?

speaker: STICK
line: All of it. Roxxon, Midland Circle, the damn hole, Elektra...

speaker: MATT
line: All right, you've been using this war as an excuse since the day I met you, and you still haven't told me a goddamn thing about it. You know what I think?

speaker: STICK
line: Tell me.

speaker: MATT
line: I think you're full of shit. I don't think there is any war. I think you're just a sick old fighter dying to hit people, so you make up stories to justify your behavior. And then, you rope in the wounded... so that you can sit back and watch them throw away their lives, and you can feel important.

speaker: STICK
line: Sit down. Sit down, Matty. It all began centuries ago. Nobody knows how many, but the shit we're dipping into... is ancient. Back then, warlords and their gangs ruled the countryside. Not that much different from today. Bloodthirsty, greedy brutes after loot, pussy, booze, same ol', same ol'. But... one day, one of these collections of assholes comes across a thing they can barely understand. Real treasure. Not gold, or rubies, or any of that. They found the secret.

speaker: MATT
line: What secret?

speaker: STICK
line: Immortality. Bringing the dead back to life.

speaker: MATT
line: Come on, Stick.

speaker: STICK
line: I thought you were a Catholic, Matty.

speaker: MATT
line: That's different.

speaker: STICK
line: Why? You got your God, they got theirs. And this one's real. A lot of cultures, all around the world, have a version of this story. About a thing... substance. They call it a lot of names. The lifeblood of the Earth is the one I prefer.

speaker: MATT
line: What is it?

speaker: STICK
line: Nobody knows exactly. But it's been here since the beginning. And every few hundred years, enough of it gathers in one place to... change things. The first time anyone tried to harness it, create something, they made a weapon instead. And that weapon... was The Hand.

speaker: MATT
line: The Hand?

speaker: STICK
line: An organization. Started by five fingers of the same hand in Japan. Criminals. They found it, figured out how to use it. They stayed hidden for centuries. Bleeding the Earth dry. Waiting for the right time to strike. Now they're here. In New York. And they're after something. Something big.

speaker: MATT
line: What?

speaker: STICK
line: That's what we've been trying to figure out. But whatever it is, it's in that hole. Under Midland Circle.

speaker: MATT
line: How does Elektra fit into all this?

speaker: STICK
line: She's been fighting The Hand her whole life. Since she was a kid. I trained her. Like I trained you.

speaker: MATT
line: Why didn't you tell me?

speaker: STICK
line: Because I needed you both for different reasons. And I didn't want you getting involved with each other. Complications.

speaker: MATT
line: Too late for that.

speaker: STICK
line: I can see that. Look, Matty. The Hand... they're not like anything you've faced before. They're not just killers. They're something else. Something darker.

speaker: MATT
line: What do you mean?

speaker: STICK
line: They don't fear death. Because for them, death isn't the end. They come back. Over and over again. Until you stop them for good.

speaker: MATT
line: How do you do that?

speaker: STICK
line: You cut off the head. And you make sure it stays off.

speaker: FOGGY
line: Fan club's here. Word must have gotten out about Frank testifying.

speaker: KAREN
line: Matt better show.

speaker: FOGGY
line: If he doesn't, we'll survive. Right?

speaker: MATT
line: Karen, I'm so sorry about...

speaker: KAREN
line: Uh, Foggy wants to walk through some things with you.

speaker: MATT
line: Yeah, you wanted me here?

speaker: FOGGY
line: Wow. Let's be clear. You're not here because you're a better lawyer or person. You're here because you're almost as crazy as Frank Castle, and that's it.

speaker: MATT
line: So you called me here to insult me?

speaker: FOGGY
line: I called you here to be useful, for a change. We need to get Frank to tell his story in a way that keeps him out of prison and alive. No one's heard that story except for you, because you're who you are. Why don't you put all that torture you put me and Karen through to good use? Now would be the time.

speaker: JUDGE
line: Counsel, we about ready?

speaker: FOGGY
line: Uh, one more moment, Your Honor.

speaker: MATT
line: Did you read the notes from Schoonover and Lee?

speaker: FOGGY
line: Yeah.

speaker: MATT
line: Okay, here's the play. Walk Frank through his story. Connect the dots between the Colonel and the neurologist. We don't have to prove that Frank's version of events is true. We just have to convince the jury that he believes it, and he relives it every day. We can put this guy in the loony bin, where he belongs.

speaker: JUDGE
line: Counsel?

speaker: FOGGY
line: Yeah. Uh, Your Honor, the Defense would like to call Frank Castle to the stand.

speaker: JUDGE
line: Bailiff, bring in the defendant, please.

speaker: KAREN
line: Tell me what's going on.

speaker: FOGGY
line: Frank's wearing a suit. He looks better than I ever have, and he's not even wearing a tie.

speaker: JUDGE
line: Order.

speaker: MATT
line: Think about what you want, Frank.

speaker: FOGGY
line: Something's not right.

speaker: KAREN
line: No turning back now.

speaker: BAILIFF
line: Do you solemnly swear that you will tell the truth, the whole truth, and nothing but the truth, so help you God?

speaker: FRANK
line: Yeah.

speaker: BAILIFF
line: Please state your name for the record.

speaker: FRANK
line: Frank Castle.

speaker: MATT
line: Mr. Castle, you've been charged with multiple capital crimes. Been called a killer incapable of empathy or remorse.

speaker: FRANK
line: Hmm. Yeah. So I hear.

speaker: MATT
line: Frank... May I call you Frank?

speaker: FRANK
line: Yeah.

speaker: MATT
line: Frank, we've heard a lot about neuro-chemistry... and psychology, and all things unfolding, scientifically and otherwise, inside your brain. But I just have one question I want to ask. What happened that day? The day your family was so tragically killed.

speaker: FRANK
line: It's okay, Frank.

speaker: MATT
line: I understand, it's difficult.

speaker: FRANK
line: Do you? Do you understand? 'Cause I don't think you understand shit.

speaker: MATT
line: I'd like permission to treat the witness as hostile, Your Honor?

speaker: JUDGE
line: Granted.

speaker: MATT
line: All right, Frank. You don't want to tell us? I'll tell you. I'm gonna tell you exactly what kind of man you are. You're the kind of man this city needs. Because, ladies and gentlemen of the jury, we all know this city needs help. Needs it now. Not tomorrow, not next week, not when the day comes, when the corruption that Wilson Fisk left in his wake is flushed out for good, and the police force is finally back on its feet. We need it now. 'Cause this city's been sick. And the cops, they can't fix it alone, they need... We all need men and women who are willing to take the fight themselves. The kind of people who risk their lives so that we can walk safe at night in our own neighborhoods. The ones our esteemed District Attorney here is trying so hard to destroy. New York needs these people. We need... heroes.

speaker: JUDGE
line: Order.

speaker: MATT
line: The help they offer... ...and the hope that they provide. Frank Castle wanted to help, but he took it too far. He shot people, he killed people. It's against the law. And he broke that law many, many times. Now, I don't like him any more than you do, but here's the thing, he's not a common criminal. He's not malicious in intent. Frank Castle is actually a good man. He just... He doesn't know the difference between right and wrong anymore. And he doesn't need punishment for that. He needs help. Our help. That's the kind of man Frank Castle is. And now, you have to decide what kind of jury you want to be. No further questions, Your Honor.

speaker: FRANK
line: Your, uh... Your Honor? Can I say something?

speaker: JUDGE
line: You may.

speaker: FRANK
line: You know those, uh... Those people? The ones I put down, the people I killed? I want you to know that I'd do it all again. This is a circus, all right? It's a charade, it's an act. It's bullshit about how crazy I am.

speaker: JUDGE
line: Language.

speaker: FRANK
line: I ain't crazy! I'm not crazy. Okay? I know what I did. I know who I am. And I do not need your help. I'm smack-dab in the middle of my right goddamn mind, and any scumbag, any... any lowlife, any maggot piece of shit that I put down, I did it... because I liked it!

speaker: JUDGE
line: Order!

speaker: FRANK
line: Hell, I loved it! I'm sittin' here, I'm... I'm just itching. I'm itching to do it again. And you think... What, you think you're gonna send me to a nuthouse? Some doctor, they're gonna get me to stop from doing what I want to do? Well, that ain't happening! Not on my watch! You people, you call me the Punisher, ain't that right? The big bad Punisher.

speaker: JUDGE
line: Bailiff.

speaker: FRANK
line: Well, here I am!

speaker: JUDGE
line: Remove the witness.

speaker: FRANK
line: You want it, you got it! I am the Punisher! I'm right here! You want it, I'll give it to you. And anybody who came here today to hear me whine, to hear me beg? Well, you can kiss my ass! Do you hear me? I'm guilty.

speaker: JUDGE
line: Come on, please, Judge!

speaker: FRANK
line: I'm guilty, you hear me? I'm guilty! I'm guilty! I'll kill every one of 'em! I'll kill every single one!

speaker: FOGGY
line: How the hell did this happen?

speaker: KAREN
line: That wasn't the Frank I met with yesterday.

speaker: MATT
line: Guys... I think somebody got to him.

speaker: FOGGY
line: Convincing him of what? Yelling his way to multiple life sentences?

speaker: KAREN
line: You provoked him.

speaker: MATT
line: What? I didn't...

speaker: FOGGY
line: What are you talking...

speaker: KAREN
line: I had it lined up for you. We could have done this. We could have gotten the charges reduced. All you had to do was get Frank to tell his story. Instead you veer off into vigilante-land!

speaker: MATT
line: Foggy, he wasn't cooperating!

speaker: FOGGY
line: I'm glad we lost. You hear me? I'm glad.

speaker: MATT
line: Foggy...

speaker: KAREN
line: Karen, let him go.

speaker: FOGGY
line: I don't want to hear it. Karen, can I talk to you for five seconds, please?

speaker: KAREN
line: I don't want to hear another bullshit excuse! Maybe you are an alcoholic. Maybe you're in a fight club. Maybe you are sleeping with a whole harem of women. I don't care, I'm done. You're right. This city really needs heroes. But you're not one of them.

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: You gotta feel like shit.

speaker: MATT
line: Go back to bed.

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: I can barely stand.

speaker: MATT
line: Then go back to bed.

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: No. I don't want to be with you anymore. I want to be with him.

speaker: STICK
line: Don't be stupid.

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: He needs more training. The Hand is new to him...

speaker: STICK
line: Soft. Matt Murdock is soft. He made you soft. You let your guard down. Go back to bed, Ellie.

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: I'm not a child.

speaker: STICK
line: You can't be with him.

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: Why?

speaker: STICK
line: You can't change what you are.

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: Matthew thinks I can. And I believe him.

speaker: STICK
line: Get out... before I get nasty.

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: Are you threatening me?

speaker: STICK
line: You're damn right, I am.

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: Go.

speaker: STICK
line: What do you think he'll say... when he finds out... what you are? What you've always been? Haven't told him yet... have ya?

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: Get out.

speaker: STICK
line: Aside from saving your ass... you have no idea what I've protected you from.

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: I can protect myself.

speaker: STICK
line: We'll find out. Enough with these amateurs. Time to get the band back together. Head to the Wall.

speaker: MATT
line: Where's Stick?

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: I made my choice. He didn't like it. I want to be with you. The only person in this world who believes I'm good.

speaker: MATT
line: You lost today.

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: It doesn't matter.

speaker: MATT
line: You lost more than just the case.

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: Yeah. I didn't lose you.

speaker: MATT
line: I'm sorry.

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: I'm not.

speaker: MATT
line: How does this work? You and me? How can we make it work?

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: I don't know. But we're gonna figure it out. Not now, though. Right now, you need to rest.

speaker: MATT
line: Who do you work for? Huh? Who sent you? Answer me! Huh? You tell them, whoever they are, I'm gonna find them, and when I do, I'm gonna... No... You're... You're just a kid.

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: Elektra, no... No... What did you do?

speaker: MATT
line: This is who I am. Do you still want me?

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: Matthew. Matthew!

speaker: MATT
line: You're okay... You're okay...

speaker: GUARD 1
line: I got this one.

speaker: GUARD 2
line: On whose orders?

speaker: GUARD 1
line: The warden's. You got a problem with that?

speaker: GUARD 2
line: No one tells us anything down here.

speaker: PRISONER
line: Hey, look at me, Frank! Look at me! I'm gonna stick you! That's a promise! I promise you!

speaker: FRANK
line: Right through here.

speaker: KINGPIN
line: I see you got my message.

speaker: GUARD
line: All right, watch your head. Inmate 5-5-4-6-7. Fisk, Wilson.

speaker: GUARD 2
line: Everything off. Clothing and personal items in the bin. Newbies wear white. That's yours.

speaker: DONOVAN
line: I deeply regret that it's come to this, Mr. Fisk. I assure you my firm did everything we could... but the case against you was, quite simply, bulletproof.

speaker: FISK
line: How is the progress regarding my appeal, Mr. Donovan?

speaker: DONOVAN
line: We're making progress, but I have to be honest. Given the magnitude of charges, we were lucky we could plead you out at all.

speaker: FISK
line: Vanessa, huh?

speaker: DONOVAN
line: I've secured a percentage of your holdings offshore, as requested.

speaker: FISK
line: She wants to come see you.

speaker: DONOVAN
line: She can't. She must stay where she's safe for the time being.

speaker: FISK
line: Of course. She'll have everything she needs. But with that said, you need to understand that a good number of your assets were seized by the government, Mr. Fisk. Your remaining capital is... limited.

speaker: DONOVAN
line: How long will she be safe for?

speaker: FISK
line: Long enough.

speaker: DONOVAN
line: Mr. Fisk, I'm doing everything I can to get you out, but we're talking about a process that could take months, maybe years. In the interim, we need you to keep your head down and avoid trouble while you're in here. The state will jump on any infraction to shoot down an early release... to keep you inside. It's the best move, Mr. Fisk. In fact, it's the only move.

speaker: FISK
line: Those you cannot teach to fly, teach to fall faster.

speaker: DUTTON
line: Wilson Fisk. The boogeyman of crime. The man who cast a shadow in the dark.

speaker: FISK
line: You'll stop reading those eventually. It's best to accept that real life is what happens on the inside.

speaker: DUTTON
line: Maybe your life, Mr. Dutton, not mine.

speaker: FISK
line: We never met before, have we?

speaker: DUTTON
line: No, but your reputation precedes you. A life of running drugs buys you that much in New York City. You may have made a name for yourself on the outside... but I run the big box. I just wanna make that clear... in case you get any ideas about stepping up.

speaker: FISK
line: I have no intentions of doing that.

speaker: DUTTON
line: Cut the shit, fat man. I've known guys like you my whole life. I killed most of 'em. You ain't never seen a throne you didn't wanna sit in. So I'm here to make myself crystal clear. There's only room for one of us in this prison, and it ain't gonna be you. Not ever. Because I'm the kingpin of this bitch.

speaker: DUTTON
line: Catch you later.

speaker: STEWART
line: Mind if I sit?

speaker: FISK
line: Fine.

speaker: STEWART
line: I won't bother you. Just wanted to meet. You know, in here, guys like us need to stick together.

speaker: FISK
line: Guys like us?

speaker: STEWART
line: I was a mortgage analyst on the outside. Seven figure salary, summer house in the Hamptons. Just made the wrong deal, crossed the wrong guy. It turned out that his brother was some bigwig in the Justice Department. Some luck, huh? Look, what I mean is... we're not like these savages in here. That's all. Smart to steer clear of that asshole.

speaker: FISK
line: It's not just the guys at his table that are on his side. He runs about 80% of the contraband in this place. Most of the guards are in his pocket, from what I can tell.

speaker: STEWART
line: The two men you were speaking to.

speaker: FISK
line: Valdez brothers.

speaker: STEWART
line: They your friends?

speaker: FISK
line: Slim pickings in here, but, yeah. Yeah, they don't talk much. Let's just say what they did to get in here was ghastly.

speaker: STEWART
line: Do they have family?

speaker: FISK
line: A mother. She'll be alone for a while.

speaker: DONOVAN
line: I wish I had better news, Mr. Fisk, but the appeal...

speaker: FISK
line: I didn't ask you here for that.

speaker: DONOVAN
line: Oh.

speaker: FISK
line: I need you to write down the following. The office of Caplan and Dayhill... they have a client, his name is Stewart Finney. He needs his legal retainer bolstered.

speaker: DONOVAN
line: What?

speaker: FISK
line: Andrea Valdez. She's 62. She lives in Spanish Harlem. Needs her rent paid indefinitely.

speaker: DONOVAN
line: What is this?

speaker: FISK
line: Untraceable, if you handle it correctly.

speaker: DONOVAN
line: Mr. Fisk, I warned you about getting involved in the...

speaker: FISK
line: Get it done!

speaker: GUARD
line: Fisk.

speaker: FISK
line: Anything on Dutton?

speaker: GUARD
line: He and his men haven't emerged from block A today. No way to get in. That wing's impenetrable.

speaker: FISK
line: For now.

speaker: GUARD
line: The paper's interesting, though. Check out the front page. The Punisher. Apparently, he gunned down the Irish in a big way.

speaker: FISK
line: Mmm, Nesbitt was a problematic leader.

speaker: GUARD
line: He took out the Dogs of Hell, too. Blew up their clubhouse. They charged him with 37 counts of murder.

speaker: FISK
line: Wow, perhaps his name suits him.

speaker: GUARD
line: I'd say. Rumor is some of the Cartel got meat hooks through their faces.

speaker: FISK
line: The Cartel?

speaker: GUARD
line: The Mexicans.

speaker: FISK
line: If I'm correct... Dutton didn't do business with the Cartel. On the 22nd, Dutton's lieutenant mentioned... a deal with the Aryans to move product in the Dogs' territory. A hostile takeover. Does Dutton have connections with the Irish?

speaker: GUARD
line: Some heroin deal gone south. That was a while back, though.

speaker: FISK
line: I know what I'm asking for will be difficult.

speaker: GUARD
line: I'm not worried about difficult. I'm not even worried about illegal. Your funds have almost been depleted. Building up your little protection crew wasn't cheap.

speaker: FISK
line: Nor should it be.

speaker: GUARD
line: Your cash is almost gone. If I do this, that's it. After that, anything you need for the rest of your stay, you'll be dipping into the reserves, into Vanessa's protection.

speaker: FISK
line: I won't need anything after this.

speaker: GUARD
line: This guard you've spoken to, do I want to know what you'll be asking him to do?

speaker: FISK
line: I see you got my message.

speaker: FRANK
line: Shh, I've got you, Matthew.

speaker: FISK
line: Who's... who's there?

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: Elektra?

speaker: MATT
line: Oh, slowly. You okay?

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: Where is he?

speaker: MATT
line: Stick? He left. Remember?

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: No, not Stick. The boy. The one you killed.

speaker: MATT
line: It's been taken care of.

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: Not "it." He.

speaker: MATT
line: Well, he tried to kill you.

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: He was scared. He was just a kid.

speaker: MATT
line: If you'd spared him, he would've sent his big brothers after us. I killed him in self-defense. Even your precious court of law would say that's legitimate...

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: It doesn't work that way.

speaker: MATT
line: Well... it's a good thing I'm not on trial.

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: We need to tell the police.

speaker: MATT
line: Tell them what? I killed a member of an ancient organization of ninjas that are digging a giant hole in midtown Manhattan? Perhaps we should. Maybe they need a laugh.

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: But you and I, we've seen it. The Hand is very real. And they know we're onto them. The battle has begun, Matthew. There's nothing we can do about it now but fight.

speaker: MATT
line: Look... I wish I could tell you that I'm not going to pull my sword... but I will if I have to.

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: You said you wanted to be good.

speaker: MATT
line: I do.

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: But you don't. I saw it ten years ago with Roscoe Sweeney... and I saw it again last night. Your adrenaline spiked, Elektra. You enjoy killing.

speaker: MATT
line: And you may say you wanna be good for me, but that's not who you really are, is it?

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: The first time I took a life... I was 12 years old. I did it of my own volition. I wasn't saving another. I wasn't even protecting myself. I did it... because I needed to know that I could. Not that I could get away with it. Not that I could get used to it.

speaker: MATT
line: And you enjoyed it.

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: You know, Stick taught us to never let anyone get close.

speaker: MATT
line: I fell in love with you.

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: I loved you, too. That wasn't a lie.

speaker: MATT
line: I fell in love with you, so I don't want to keep judging you for who you are. And this... this is who I am.

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: We have to stop corrupting each other. We can't do this anymore. Say something.

speaker: MATT
line: The Hand will decimate your city.

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: Not if I stop them.

speaker: MATT
line: You'll die.

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: Yeah, maybe. But this is a war I need to fight alone. Goodbye, Elektra.

speaker: FISK
line: The circumstances are unfortunate, but each loss brings opportunity. I'm glad we have this chance to meet.

speaker: FRANK
line: Hmm. You have something you wanna say to me?

speaker: FISK
line: I've been following your case... as much as one could in this cage. I want you to know... what happened to your family that day...

speaker: FRANK
line: Don't you do that. You don't talk about my family. You got that? Just don't do it.

speaker: FISK
line: I consider it a tragedy.

speaker: FRANK
line: That right? You can save your bullshit sympathy, 'cause I don't buy it.

speaker: FISK
line: I understand why you'd think that.

speaker: FRANK
line: Look, you got something to say to me or not?

speaker: FISK
line: Yes. I've crossed paths with your attorneys... before. Needless to say, I'm not a... a huge fan. Pushing you towards a sentence in a mental health facility, after everything you've been through, that would have been a travesty.

speaker: FRANK
line: As opposed to what?

speaker: FISK
line: Closure. Since I've been incarcerated, I've developed an empathy towards those who suffer by the hand of the law.

speaker: FRANK
line: I think I've heard enough of your bullshit, okay? You said closure. What'd you mean?

speaker: FISK
line: There's a man, here, in the big box. He's a prisoner. He's been overheard... boasting about his involvement with several criminal factions.

speaker: FRANK
line: This man... he most definitely had a hand in the massacre in the park.

speaker: FISK
line: I want a name.

speaker: FRANK
line: He's in another cell block...

speaker: FISK
line: I didn't ask you that.

speaker: FRANK
line: Which he essentially owns, heavily guarded by guards and inmates alike.

speaker: FISK
line: I don't give a shit. I want a name.

speaker: FRANK
line: Dutton. He's not Irish. He's not Cartel. He's not a biker. He's something else entirely. I believe that he facilitated the deal... that led to your wife and children being gunned down in broad daylight.

speaker: FRANK
line: You put me in a position to get to him... and I'll find out the truth.

speaker: FISK
line: Consider it done.

speaker: DUTTON
line: What the hell?

speaker: FRANK
line: Now, you make any noise, anything at all, I'm gonna open you up like a bag. I'll watch you bleed out all over this floor. Now, you nod if you understand me.

speaker: DUTTON
line: Okay.

speaker: FRANK
line: Shh. Stanton massacre. The carousel hit. I hear you were there.

speaker: DUTTON
line: What if I was?

speaker: FRANK
line: You're a goddamn lunatic. What the hell were you doing there?

speaker: DUTTON
line: Drug deal. I was brokering between three groups of assholes who barely spoke the same language.

speaker: FRANK
line: What happened?

speaker: DUTTON
line: What do you think happened?

speaker: FRANK
line: Tell me who started the shooting.

speaker: DUTTON
line: What?

speaker: FRANK
line: You tell me who pulled the trigger. Who made the order?

speaker: DUTTON
line: It went south.

speaker: FRANK
line: What do you mean, "It went south"? It happens.

speaker: DUTTON
line: What does that mean, "It went south"? What do you mean?

speaker: FRANK
line: It means we're not as dumb as they thought we were. We realized what it was.

speaker: DUTTON
line: What was it?

speaker: FRANK
line: It wasn't a massacre, asshole. It was a sting.

speaker: DUTTON
line: A what?

speaker: FRANK
line: My source warned me. The feds infiltrated one of the gangs. I'm not sure which. They found out how big the deal was. Massive exchange. A real game changer. But they weren't after any of us. They were after the man in charge, the man who organized the whole damn thing.

speaker: DUTTON
line: Who's that? Who is that? I want a name.

speaker: FRANK
line: I never met him. He never showed his face. All I know is he had a line on pure heroin. Shit shipped from the Middle East. They called him the Blacksmith.

speaker: DUTTON
line: The whole thing should've went by the numbers, but he got wise. He stayed away. And when they realized he wasn't gonna show, someone started shooting. That's all I know. I swear... to God.

speaker: FRANK
line: I heard about you. News travels fast around here. But there were almost 100 bangers that day, and every finger found a trigger. You know, this crusade of yours... it's never gonna end, right? Right?

speaker: DUTTON
line: Yeah... yeah, you're right. You're right.

speaker: FRANK
line: Open the door. Open the door.

speaker: DUTTON
line: What are you doing?

speaker: FRANK
line: Open the goddamn door.

speaker: FRANK
line: Hey. Hey. Mr. Castle... thank you. I couldn't have done it without you.

speaker: INMATES
line: They got Dutton! Holy shit, man! There he is. There he is. You're a dead man. Let's go! Let's go! Let's go! Come on. You're dead!

speaker: GUARD
line: Inmate! Fall on your knees!

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: Open up! Not strong enough. Hai. Mmm.

speaker: SECURITY
line: We found two guards unconscious in the Roxxon garage.

speaker: NOBU
line: What were they protecting?

speaker: SECURITY
line: Stan Gibson, sir.

speaker: NOBU
line: Find him. The process is almost complete.

speaker: DAREDEVIL
line: Tell your man to stand down. Don't shoot. Lower the gun. Lower the gun!

speaker: GIBSON
line: There are more men outside.

speaker: DAREDEVIL
line: Not conscious ones. Tell me about the Farm. What are you growing here?

speaker: NOBU
line: I am not afraid to hurt you.

speaker: DAREDEVIL
line: I know you're not. But you are not the only devil who will walk these streets.

speaker: NOBU
line: What's in the basement?

speaker: DAREDEVIL
line: The rising is coming. You are but one man, akuma-san. You cannot stop what we have started.

speaker: DAREDEVIL
line: What is that?

speaker: NOBU
line: That's blood.

speaker: ELLISON
line: It wasn't just a random gang shootout. It was a sting.

speaker: KAREN
line: Who knows who's involved?

speaker: ELLISON
line: Cops, DA's office, obviously.

speaker: KAREN
line: The mayor? How high does this go?

speaker: ELLISON
line: I don't know. But I can tell by that look in your eye that you're not gonna get any rest till you figure it out. So if you wanna camp out in here... it's all yours. Start digging.

speaker: KAREN
line: Are you serious?

speaker: ELLISON
line: I'm very serious. Ben was the best researcher I've ever known.

speaker: KAREN
line: I remember.

speaker: ELLISON
line: Did you...

speaker: KAREN
line: Read that? Yes. Yeah, I... I read it. Look, Ben didn't care, and I don't, either. Get to work, okay? Go.

speaker: FISK
line: Are you sure that's a good idea, Mr. Fisk?

speaker: GUARD
line: Go now! How quickly we turn into savages. As if the moment we walk through these prison doors...

speaker: FRANK
line: You tried to have me killed.

speaker: FISK
line: Yes, it would've been cleaner that way, but you got what you wanted! Given the condition that he was in, I assume that Dutton admitted to some involvement in your tragedy.

speaker: FRANK
line: What do you want? Why am I still alive?

speaker: FISK
line: Because plans change. Because if you want to survive, you adapt. Yes! The plan was to kill you. I needed to close that loop. I'd already made a deal with the rest of the guards. I doubled the cut that Dutton was paying them. But that didn't work out, did it? No, I was wrong. That's difficult to admit, but... you have a gift, Mr. Castle. I assumed that the stories that I read in the paper about your attacks on the criminal world were apocryphal. How could one man be capable of such... violence? But then I saw it... with my own two eyes. And when one comes across someone with such talent... with such a gift... well... you don't let that go to waste. No. No, you don't.

speaker: FRANK
line: How's that?

speaker: FISK
line: Release him.

speaker: GUARD
line: Mr. Fisk, I...

speaker: FISK
line: Do it now!

speaker: FRANK
line: What the hell is this?

speaker: FISK
line: I'm in control now. And I've set you free.

speaker: FRANK
line: What does that mean, "free"?

speaker: FISK
line: I'll show you.

speaker: FRANK
line: Stay back. 'Cause everyone warned me that prison would be an inhumane environment. It is. But I... I find it refreshing. The perfect microcosm of the animal world. When an animal wants something, when it needs something, other things... need to be stepped on.

speaker: FISK
line: You want me on the outside so I step on every piece of shit I see. That way, nobody gets strong, and we... The city's yours for the taking.

speaker: FRANK
line: Something like that. Yeah.

speaker: FISK
line: So if you can do that, if you can get me out, why not just do it yourself?

speaker: FRANK
line: Because I play the long game, Mr. Castle. You see, when I'm finally let out of this cage... it won't be to wage war. It will be to win one. You, sir... you need to focus on now. I've given you a chance to walk free. To put that gift of yours to work, to find... What does Dutton call him? The Blacksmith.

speaker: FISK
line: If I were in your shoes... I would use this opportunity to find your justice, to kill your way to justice! And not for me. Of course not. Not for yourself. For your family. For them.

speaker: FRANK
line: Fisk.

speaker: FISK
line: Yes?

speaker: FRANK
line: You know... next time I see you... only one of us walks away.

speaker: FISK
line: Yes, of course. I'm counting on it.

speaker: DAREDEVIL
line: Is someone there?

speaker: GIBSON
line: Someone... These people... Jesus. What are they doing to you?

speaker: PRISONER
line: Daniel. Daniel!

speaker: GIBSON
line: Daniel. Oh, Daniel! We're gonna get them out. Stan, we're gonna get them all out.

speaker: PRISONER
line: Daniel, my boy. Oh, my boy. Oh, my boy.

speaker: GIBSON
line: Keys.

speaker: PRISONER
line: Just hold on, my son. Come here. Thank God. Thank God. God.

speaker: DAREDEVIL
line: Get down!

speaker: NOBU
line: They weren't finished.

speaker: FISK
line: The physician says that your condition is... is grave. That your lungs are filling with liquid. In a few hours, you're likely to suffocate in your own blood. But you won't suffer alone. I'll be here. Because you were right. In prison, there's only room for one kingpin.

speaker: DUTTON
line: You still have scars to remember me by, I hope.

speaker: FISK
line: Wait... You're dead.

speaker: NOBU
line: There is no such thing.

speaker: BRETT
line: Christ almighty.

speaker: BRETT
line: What the hell happened here?

speaker: CAPTIVE
line: Please.

speaker: CAPTIVE
line: They need medical attention. Please. Please.

speaker: BRETT
line: Thompson, help them.

speaker: THOMPSON
line: Got it.

speaker: CAPTIVE
line: Daniel, look at me.

speaker: BRETT
line: Jesus Christ.

speaker: BRETT
line: Don't let any of 'em out your sight, okay?

speaker: THOMPSON
line: Yeah, yeah.

speaker: THOMPSON
line: Okay, guys, come over here. Um, I wanna make sure we cordon off—

speaker: BRETT
line: ETA on the ambulances.

speaker: DISPATCHER (RADIO)
line: They're two out, sir.

speaker: BRETT
line: I need five of 'em to 54 St. Mark's, right away.

speaker: DAREDEVIL
line: Mahoney.

speaker: BRETT
line: Let me guess. You're the one who found 'em.

speaker: DAREDEVIL
line: The cages, the medical tubing. They were being drained.

speaker: BRETT
line: For what?

speaker: DAREDEVIL
line: Doesn't matter. We need to find the people who did this to them. It would be a good start if you told me who that was. You see anyone down there?

speaker: BRETT
line: No.

speaker: DAREDEVIL
line: But you could start with the Yakuza.

speaker: BRETT
line: "Start with"?

speaker: DAREDEVIL
line: Yeah.

speaker: BRETT
line: Shit! You saying the Yakuza is mixed up with another group?

speaker: DAREDEVIL
line: I think so.

speaker: BRETT
line: That's scarier than all this cult-looking ritual shit put together. This group— they got a name?

speaker: DAREDEVIL
line: I'm working on it.

speaker: BRETT
line: Yeah, I'll bet you are. Listen, these victims, they need to be taken somewhere off the grid, somewhere they can't be found.

speaker: DAREDEVIL
line: No. What they need is medical attention.

speaker: BRETT
line: I know, and they'll get it, but— Whatever was being done to them, it may not be over. We need to get them somewhere safe.

speaker: DAREDEVIL
line: Yeah, that might not be a bad idea. All Saints is closest...

speaker: BRETT
line: No, take them to Metro-General. I know someone there we can trust. But no one can know you're bringing them in.

speaker: DAREDEVIL
line: I'm on it. And just know, someday I'ma tell you how to do your job.

speaker: BRETT
line: Thompson, I need a favor.

speaker: CLAIRE
line: Got the last one. And he's burning up. I need a cooling blanket and ice packs.

speaker: NURSE
line: We're out.

speaker: CLAIRE
line: Jesus. Uh— Vending machine. Next floor down. Get all the cold sodas you can.

speaker: NURSE
line: Okay.

speaker: CLAIRE
line: Apply them on their wrists. We need to get the fever down.

speaker: BRETT
line: Thanks for this.

speaker: CLAIRE
line: Thank administration. They've taken six months to remodel this wing. Anything happens, you let me know. I'll keep a few PD here, and more downstairs.

speaker: BRETT
line: Okay.

speaker: CLAIRE
line: And do me a favor? Keep the details of this arrangement to yourself.

speaker: BRETT
line: Details?

speaker: CLAIRE
line: Our mutual friend.

speaker: BRETT
line: I have no idea what you're talking about.

speaker: CLAIRE
line: This ain't like any overdose I've ever seen.

speaker: NURSE
line: Yeah, their systems are in free fall.

speaker: CLAIRE
line: Holy shit.

speaker: NURSE
line: What?

speaker: CLAIRE
line: She's got no prints. Her fingertips were burnt off.

speaker: CLAIRE
line: Her, too.

speaker: NURSE
line: IDing 'em is gonna be fun.

speaker: CLAIRE
line: What kind of junkies do this?

speaker: NURSE
line: Yeah, I think this was done to them. Let's just get them stable. One headache at a time.

speaker: CLAIRE
line: You. And here I was hoping my day would get worse.

speaker: MATT
line: Hi, Claire.

speaker: CLAIRE
line: Five patients, non-responsive, high fever, no fingerprints. You wanna tell me what kind of shit storm you just rained down on me?

speaker: MATT
line: It's why I'm here.

speaker: CLAIRE
line: In here.

speaker: MATT
line: What's the story?

speaker: CLAIRE
line: It's, um— it's complicated.

speaker: MATT
line: Always is with you.

speaker: CLAIRE
line: Remember the last time you patched me up?

speaker: MATT
line: When you were cut to shreds?

speaker: CLAIRE
line: Kinda hard to forget. Well, the same guy who did that to me, he's the one responsible for your five new patients. Nobu.

speaker: MATT
line: You said he burned to death.

speaker: CLAIRE
line: Yeah. I was wrong.

speaker: MATT
line: There's gotta be more to the story than that.

speaker: CLAIRE
line: For now I need you to know that every one of these people is still in real danger.

speaker: MATT
line: Okay, I have checked their vitals.

speaker: CLAIRE
line: I know, they're hanging by a thread.

speaker: MATT
line: No. Claire, I mean— even if you manage to save their lives, someone may still come to kill them. And the people who gave them aid?

speaker: CLAIRE
line: Most likely.

speaker: MATT
line: Yes.

speaker: CLAIRE
line: Wow, Matt. I— I really have not missed you at all.

speaker: MATT
line: But, look, Claire, nobody knows they're here. And I'm gonna offer you all the protection I can. Plus, you can still send them away.

speaker: CLAIRE
line: You know I can't do that.

speaker: MATT
line: Thank you. It's why I came to you.

speaker: CLAIRE
line: Are you hurt?

speaker: MATT
line: Yeah— a little.

speaker: CLAIRE
line: "A little"? Oh.

speaker: CLAIRE
line: That's— Bone bruise. A fractured rib, most likely. It's probably busted, knowing you. I'll say this about you, Matt Murdock. You are a lot of bad things. Boring is not one of them.

speaker: CLAIRE
line: Here.

speaker: MATT
line: What is it?

speaker: CLAIRE
line: Two aspirin. Catholic morphine. Take it.

speaker: MATT
line: I don't know.

speaker: DISPATCHER (OVER RADIO)
line: All units, suspect Frank Castle. Believed to be armed and extremely dangerous.

speaker: BRETT (OVER RADIO)
line: I should've known this day would get worse. I want this out across all five boroughs. And get some additional units to the courthouse and City Hall. Do it. Move!

speaker: MATT
line: Son of a bitch.

speaker: CLAIRE
line: What is it?

speaker: MATT
line: The Punisher. He just escaped.

speaker: WOMAN
line: Miss Page?

speaker: KAREN
line: Yeah.

speaker: AGENT GALLAGHER
line: Agent Gallagher. Follow me. I'll get you through security as quickly as possible.

speaker: KAREN
line: Thank you.

speaker: AGENT GALLAGHER
line: Excuse us. Excuse me. Pardon me.

speaker: KAREN
line: Sorry.

speaker: AGENT GALLAGHER
line: Wait here.

speaker: KAREN
line: Hey.

speaker: FOGGY
line: Guess I'm not the only one that got Reyes's invitation.

speaker: KAREN
line: Security is nuts.

speaker: FOGGY
line: Frank Castle's on the loose. I wouldn't take any chances either.

speaker: KAREN
line: No, not even Frank could have orchestrated an escape that quickly. How's that even possible?

speaker: FOGGY
line: Guessing that's what the District Attorney wants to ask us.

speaker: KAREN
line: This case just keeps serving up the shit burgers.

speaker: AGENT
line: Mr. Nelson, this way.

speaker: FOGGY
line: See you on the other side.

speaker: KAREN
line: Yeah.

speaker: MAN
line: Excuse me, sir. Do you need a hand?

speaker: MATT
line: No, thank you. Thank you so much.

speaker: KAREN
line: I, uh, see Reyes dragged you in, too.

speaker: MATT
line: Karen? Are you all right?

speaker: KAREN
line: Other than being hauled in as a suspect in the escape of a confessed murderer? Yeah, I'm great.

speaker: MATT
line: Yeah, this whole case has been a disaster. I'm sorry I pulled you guys into it.

speaker: KAREN
line: Don't be sorry.

speaker: MATT
line: How are you otherwise?

speaker: KAREN
line: Good. Yeah, I'm good.

speaker: MATT
line: Good.

speaker: AGENT GALLAGHER
line: Miss Page?

speaker: KAREN
line: Come with me.

speaker: AGENT GALLAGHER
line: Yeah.

speaker: MATT
line: Mr. Murdock, I'll be right back.

speaker: FOGGY
line: According to my buddy, Reyes is most likely about to grill us like fish.

speaker: KAREN
line: She has no cause.

speaker: MATT
line: On paper, we're still Frank Castle's attorneys.

speaker: FOGGY
line: And I am so proud of that. Frank's out, but instead of going after him herself, Reyes is dragging us into the lion's den. What could we possibly know about his escape?

speaker: MATT
line: Precisely dick. But if Reyes can find a way to blame us for all this, she will.

speaker: FOGGY
line: Karen, you spent the most time with him. He say anything? Anything at all that could help us right now?

speaker: KAREN
line: Nothing about an escape.

speaker: FOGGY
line: I went over Castle's transfer work. He wasn't waltzing into some country club. They were burying him in their highest security control unit with all the other rock stars on cell block D.

speaker: KAREN
line: Uh, Matt— this way.

speaker: MATT
line: Hey, Foggy. You said cell block D?

speaker: AGENT
line: It'll be just another minute.

speaker: MATT
line: Thanks.

speaker: FOGGY
line: Does that mean something to you?

speaker: MATT
line: Yeah, I like to keep track of the people who might want to kill us.

speaker: FOGGY
line: The Punisher?

speaker: MATT
line: No, not Frank. Wilson Fisk.

speaker: KAREN
line: Frank blows his trial, and ends up on Fisk's cell block? And a day later, he's on the street.

speaker: FOGGY
line: Uh, those are two very separate dots. You can't just connect them.

speaker: MATT
line: Oh, come on, Foggy. I'm right. Fisk made this happen.

speaker: AGENT
line: She'll see you now.

speaker: REYES (ON PHONE)
line: Ma'am? They're here now.

speaker: REYES
line: Yes. As soon as possible. Please, as soon as possible.

speaker: REYES
line: Thank you for coming.

speaker: FOGGY
line: Kinda hard to say no when the cops pick you up.

speaker: REYES
line: Well, I'm sorry about that. Could you, uh— Please, have a seat. Please.

speaker: MATT
line: The second chair.

speaker: FOGGY
line: I don't know what your play is, lady, but let's cut the shit. You brought us in expecting to sweat privileged information about our client out of us.

speaker: REYES
line: Yes, if that helps. We have to get Frank Castle off the street before anyone else gets hurt.

speaker: KAREN
line: You're asking for favors, after all the shit you've pulled?

speaker: REYES
line: I didn't pull anything on anyone. I prosecuted a man who k*lled dozens of people. I put a serial killer behind bars.

speaker: FOGGY
line: And now he's out.

speaker: REYES
line: And I believe that someone helped him. And I believe that someone is Wilson Fisk.

speaker: MATT
line: Why would Fisk help Frank?

speaker: REYES
line: I have no idea. But I intend to find out. And I'm hoping you can help me with that.

speaker: KAREN
line: How?

speaker: REYES
line: By testifying before a grand jury. About everything you know regarding Frank Castle and his connection to Wilson Fisk.

speaker: MATT
line: We don't know anything about a connection.

speaker: REYES
line: Then testify to that.

speaker: FOGGY
line: You want us to go on record saying we don't know something?

speaker: REYES
line: I want you to go on record period. So that when I do connect the dots, and I will, you'll be on the right side of this.

speaker: MATT
line: And if we refuse?

speaker: REYES
line: Then you'll be on the wrong side. And I'll make sure everyone knows it.

speaker: KAREN
line: Is that a threat?

speaker: REYES
line: It's a fact. Frank Castle is a murderer. And Wilson Fisk is a criminal. And anyone who helps them, in any way, is complicit. So I'm giving you a chance to do the right thing here.

speaker: MATT
line: We'll think about it.

speaker: REYES
line: Don't think too long.

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: New York is done. Hello to?

speaker: MAN
line: Jacques.

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: Jacques Duchamps.

speaker: MAN
line: Louise Badeaux.

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: Louise. Funny—

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: I thought your name was Elektra.

speaker: MAN
line: How do you know my name?

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: I know who you are. I know what you've done, and who you have killed. The list is long. The pilot in Buenos Aires, the lawyer in Berlin— and that very messy episode in Morocco. I'm still trying to understand how one woman can fit six bodies in the trunk of a Maserati.

speaker: MAN
line: Are you gonna try to kill me?

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: Something like that.

speaker: MAN
line: Well, you ought to know it's rude to keep a girl waiting.

speaker: ELLISON
line: Just one body. Shit-ton of bullets, and a whole lot of blood.

speaker: ELLISON
line: All signs point to Frank Castle.

speaker: KAREN
line: No, no. Uh, it's not his style.

speaker: ELLISON
line: Wait, wait, wait. No, really, I, I know him. He wouldn't—

speaker: KAREN
line: What do you mean, "Not his style"?

speaker: ELLISON
line: Come here— Look, you wanna report the news, or you wanna really get to the truth? The first step is you gotta put aside your personal feelings. I— I mean about everything. No matter how much it hurts.

speaker: KAREN
line: This is not personal. I'm just saying that this does not fit. All right, this is just— That's just out of control.

speaker: ELLISON
line: Yeah, it's out of control because Frank's a killer, all right? That's chaos. Whatever good you saw, whatever you know, code of honor that you understood— it was never there.

speaker: KAREN
line: You think I projected?

speaker: ELLISON
line: Yeah. Happens to the best of us. Although, you know, why you'd wanna see good in the man who pulls the trigger is beyond me, but— Do you know anybody else who might be in danger?

speaker: KAREN
line: Um— Yes, uh, his nurse. Uh, he's a janitor now. And there's some others.

speaker: ELLISON
line: Okay, okay. So— So, listen. You gotta— you gotta get those names, all right? We have to hand everything we have to the NYPD. We need to save as many people as we can.

speaker: KAREN
line: Yeah. I've got all the files at my apartment. I could go right now.

speaker: ELLISON
line: Uh, wait, wait, wait.

speaker: ELLISON
line: Guys, can you come here?

speaker: KAREN
line: Uh, what's this?

speaker: ELLISON
line: Oh, well, they're, um— they're going with you.

speaker: KAREN
line: Are you serious?

speaker: ELLISON
line: Mmm, yeah. Yeah, I had one last string to pull, so don't screw it up, okay?

speaker: KAREN
line: No, Frank's not gonna hurt me.

speaker: ELLISON
line: Frank's a psycho killer. You would never have pulled this patriarchal shit with Ben.

speaker: KAREN
line: I can take care of myself.

speaker: ELLISON
line: You're right. And I'll never make that mistake again. Not about someone I care about.

speaker: KAREN
line: Okay.

speaker: ELLISON
line: Go, go, go.

speaker: KAREN
line: Get the files. Meet me back at the office in an hour.

speaker: ELLISON
line: Yeah. I'll be there.

speaker: KAREN
line: Don't forget you owe me a cup of coffee!

speaker: DANIEL
line: Where am I?

speaker: CLAIRE
line: Hey. You're in Metro-General, and you're safe.

speaker: DANIEL
line: No, no, no, no, no, no, no. Lie very, very still. You've been very ill. Do you remember what happened? Can you feel this?

speaker: CLAIRE
line: Good. Daniel.

speaker: DANIEL
line: Your father's here.

speaker: CLAIRE
line: Thank you.

speaker: STAN
line: Is he okay?

speaker: CLAIRE
line: Yeah. He's weak, and he'll need another transfusion, but he's coherent. Hopefully the others will respond the same way.

speaker: STAN
line: I don't know how to repay you.

speaker: CLAIRE
line: Trust me, billing will find you. I'll give you two a minute to catch up, but then the police will be wanting to question him sooner than later.

speaker: STAN
line: Yes, of course.

speaker: STAN
line: I'm so sorry. This is all my fault. I promise it's going to be better now.

speaker: CLAIRE
line: Always the last place you look. But you knew I was coming, huh?

speaker: MATT
line: I heard you. Three stories down.

speaker: CLAIRE
line: You do know that sounds creepy, right?

speaker: MATT
line: Yeah, I've been told.

speaker: CLAIRE
line: I brought you coffee.

speaker: MATT
line: No, thanks.

speaker: CLAIRE
line: Right. Forgot, you like to suffer. Well, the joke's on you 'cause our vending machine coffee really sucks.

speaker: MATT
line: Thought you'd be with your friend.

speaker: CLAIRE
line: Aren't you gonna ask me how he's doing?

speaker: MATT
line: He's fine. He's watching the game. Jets are up, seven-nothing. Ah, he just changed the channel. The hit was clean. In and out. They'll release him tomorrow. You know, the bullet wound will do wonders for his career in hip-hop.

speaker: CLAIRE
line: You should pay him a visit.

speaker: MATT
line: I can't help him, Claire.

speaker: CLAIRE
line: How do you know that?

speaker: MATT
line: 'Cause he got shot.

speaker: CLAIRE
line: Not by you.

speaker: MATT
line: No, but I dragged him into this mess.

speaker: CLAIRE
line: Maybe. Maybe— Or maybe you need to start thinking about climbing down off that cross of yours, and spending some time with us normal people for a change.

speaker: MATT
line: How are the other patients?

speaker: CLAIRE
line: Alive— thanks to you. You brought them in just in time. And one's awake.

speaker: MATT
line: What do they remember?

speaker: CLAIRE
line: Nothing yet. He's in and out. But I got all their toxicology screens back from the lab, though, and they read like a cheap science-fiction novel.

speaker: MATT
line: What's the report?

speaker: CLAIRE
line: Eight separate unidentified organic substances in their bloodstreams, or what was left of their bloodstreams.

speaker: MATT
line: What do you mean?

speaker: CLAIRE
line: They didn't just lose blood— they were drained. All of them. Each bled, carefully, systematically— probably for several months.

speaker: MATT
line: Yeah. Nobu took blood out, but you're saying he put toxins in?

speaker: CLAIRE
line: One of our doctors thinks that maybe they were being used to incubate the substances in their systems.

speaker: MATT
line: Like human chemical farms—

speaker: CLAIRE
line: Jesus.

speaker: MATT
line: That could be tapped as needed.

speaker: CLAIRE
line: God!

speaker: MATT
line: I should have stopped this.

speaker: CLAIRE
line: You know you kind of did, right?

speaker: MATT
line: Yeah, not soon enough.

speaker: CLAIRE
line: I don't believe this.

speaker: CLAIRE
line: Hey, uh, St. Matthew— enough with the hair shirt, already. You know, we've got doctors on it. Cops, labs— You're not the only person in Hell's Kitchen who gives a shit about what's going on here. You look like hell, you know that? And you're standing up here, freezing your ass off playing guard dog when what you really need is probably three days' sleep.

speaker: MATT
line: Yeah, 'cause Nobu's gonna figure out where we are. And when he does, I wanna be here.

speaker: CLAIRE
line: Of course, you do. Claire, what do you— what do you expect from me, all right? I'm flailing here. A dead guy— A guy I witnessed burned to death, is somehow back in Hell's Kitchen. All right? On top of that, Frank Castle kills the DA, and Wilson Fisk runs the prison that I sent him to.

speaker: CLAIRE
line: How do you know that?

speaker: MATT
line: I went there.

speaker: CLAIRE
line: Busy boy.

speaker: MATT
line: Oh, jeez. I thought it could work. I did. The law— But it feels useless. Everything I do just gets undone.

speaker: CLAIRE
line: You're talking to someone who patches up the same three crackheads every night. I understand what it's like to be pulled in a hundred different directions at once.

speaker: MATT
line: Not like this. I'm done, Claire. No more law. No more friends. At best, they're a distraction. At worst— I put them in jeopardy. From now on, I need to focus.

speaker: CLAIRE
line: You may feel like you are a ship lost at sea, but if you isolate like this, then you really will be. You're cutting off your own anchor.

speaker: MATT
line: Yeah.

speaker: CLAIRE
line: And every minute that you spend standing, hiding in this suit of armor, the more separate you become from the very things that you wanna protect. Your friend is in a hospital bed downstairs. Stop playing the loneliest little soldier, and come downstairs. Be a human being and come say "hi." That's all you gotta do. Come on. Matt?

speaker: MATT
line: Thanks for the coffee.

speaker: COP
line: Clear. You live alone?

speaker: KAREN
line: You wanna ask me out, or you wanna wait outside?

speaker: KAREN
line: Officers? Hello?

speaker: KAREN
line: Hands on your head, Frank.

speaker: KAREN
line: I mean it.

speaker: FRANK
line: It wasn't me.

speaker: KAREN
line: Hands on your head or I will unload this thing, I swear to Christ!

speaker: FRANK
line: It wasn't me. Do it.

speaker: KAREN
line: Okay. Okay. Hey.

speaker: KAREN
line: Jesus Christ!

speaker: FRANK
line: You believe me now?

speaker: KAREN
line: I believe you. I believe you.

speaker: FRANK
line: Okay.

speaker: FRANK
line: You gotta get out of here. Stay low. Go, stay low.

speaker: FISK
line: Miguel?

speaker: MIGUEL
line: Yes, Mr. Fisk?

speaker: FISK
line: I'd like you to call Mr. Donovan. I'd like to reexamine Matthew Murdock's files.

speaker: MIGUEL
line: Yes, sir.

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: Listen to me, asshole. I don't care what the Hand wants, with me or anyone else. This is not my war.

speaker: ASSASSIN
line: The Hand didn't send me.

speaker: ASSASSIN
line: Stick did.

speaker: CLAIRE
line: Great. Now what?

speaker: NURSE
line: Hey. What are you—

speaker: CLAIRE
line: Oh, my God. What did you—

speaker: CLAIRE
line: Now, watch out. One of them killed his father with a scalpel. I don't know about the rest, but don't take any chances. We just need to quarantine them until the cops can—

speaker: LOUISA
line: Claire— Oh, my God!

speaker: LOUISA
line: What the hell?

speaker: CLAIRE
line: Temple!

speaker: CLAIRE
line: No! Louisa!

speaker: DANIEL
line: Don't let him take us back down there.

speaker: MATT
line: So, there's this organization. Its members believe in some pretty strange shit. And they have deep pockets, even deeper connections all over Hell's Kitchen.

speaker: CLAIRE
line: Like a cult?

speaker: MATT
line: It's kinda hard to explain. They call themselves the Hand. Nobu's one of them. Those killers who attacked us, I think they work for him.

speaker: CLAIRE
line: Why did they want those patients back?

speaker: MATT
line: Honestly, I don't know.

speaker: CLAIRE
line: That candle that you're burning at both ends? Sooner or later, it's gonna fizzle out.

speaker: MATT
line: I'm fine. Really.

speaker: CLAIRE
line: You know the problem with martyrs? The good ones end up dead. You know, it's— it's one thing to try to take on the mob, or to block some shady real estate deal. But this stuff?

speaker: MATT
line: Those people just killed your friend.

speaker: CLAIRE
line: I know!

speaker: MATT
line: I can't just let that happen, Claire. Not in my city.

speaker: CLAIRE
line: It's not your city anymore! Matt, admit you're in over your head. There's no shame in that.

speaker: MATT
line: Yeah? When? Oh— I'll be right down. Thanks. Hey, I gotta go. It's important.

speaker: CLAIRE
line: Okay.

speaker: MATT
line: Really am sorry.

speaker: CLAIRE
line: So am I.

speaker: MAHONEY
line: We're almost done.

speaker: KAREN
line: Thanks.

speaker: MAHONEY
line: Just want to go over your statement one more time. You're sure you didn't see anything unusual outside your apartment?

speaker: KAREN
line: Not that I remember. And the man who blindsided the two officers, you couldn't tell if it was Castle?

speaker: MAHONEY
line: Like I said in my statement, when the shooting began, I hit the decks and stayed there. I didn't see anything.

speaker: KAREN
line: Smart. Powell, I think we're good. Go ahead and pull your car around.

speaker: KAREN
line: Are you okay?

speaker: MAHONEY
line: It's been a long night.

speaker: KAREN
line: Have there been any developments?

speaker: MAHONEY
line: Besides making sure Castle's face is plastered across every TV channel and newspaper? The DA and the medical examiner are dead, the same asshole takes a shot at you, and so far nobody in this entire city's seen a damn thing. I'm... I'm sorry. That wasn't, uh, very professional.

speaker: KAREN
line: Mmm. Like you said, it's been a long night.

speaker: MAHONEY
line: We'll nail him. Until then, I'm just glad you agreed to accept police protection.

speaker: KAREN
line: I appreciate the offer.

speaker: MAHONEY
line: All right, the car's outside. Powell and Reed will escort you to a safe location. We'll keep someone posted outside, 24/7.

speaker: KAREN
line: Right.

speaker: MAHONEY
line: If you remember anything, anything— you know where to find me.

speaker: KAREN
line: Sorry, he's, uh— Can you give me a minute? Thanks. Matt.

speaker: MATT
line: Karen.

speaker: KAREN
line: What are you doing here?

speaker: MATT
line: Brett reached out. Someone shot at you?

speaker: KAREN
line: Yeah, it's— it's okay. I'm fine.

speaker: MATT
line: Why didn't you call me?

speaker: KAREN
line: Would you have answered? Look, Matt, I know that you mean well, but I can take care of myself.

speaker: MATT
line: No, you can't, Karen. Not if Frank Castle wants you dead. No one can.

speaker: KAREN
line: You're right! You're right! Castle's dangerous, and maybe I can't handle this, but I don't want your help.

speaker: MATT
line: What's going on with you? What are you holding back?

speaker: KAREN
line: Frank didn't do this, okay? Matter of fact, he saved me.

speaker: MATT
line: What?

speaker: KAREN
line: He was at my apartment last night. And if he hadn't been watching the place, I'd be dead. Except the cops have it all wrong. Frank didn't kill Reyes. But whoever did knew that Frank would take the blame, and what do you know, every cop in New York City wants Punisher's head on a stick.

speaker: MATT
line: You told this to the police?

speaker: KAREN
line: No.

speaker: MATT
line: Great! Lying to the cops. Smart, Karen.

speaker: KAREN
line: But that's my problem, not yours. Frank thinks he can find this guy faster than the NYPD, and, honestly, I agree with him. He saved my life and he asked me for time. I— I owe him that much.

speaker: MATT
line: Not saying I'm going along with this, but if Castle's not the shooter, who is?

speaker: KAREN
line: Everything points back to the Central Park sting. That's where everything fell apart. What Reyes mentioned.

speaker: MATT
line: This Blacksmith?

speaker: KAREN
line: Mmm-hmm. Right. Frank has a source in prison. Turns out the DA was right, that the Blacksmith arranged the meet.

speaker: MATT
line: Why would the Blacksmith come after you?

speaker: KAREN
line: I've been working with Ellison at the Bulletin.

speaker: MATT
line: Yep. Yeah, that'll be it. When— when, when did this start?

speaker: KAREN
line: Ever since the trial. When I was trying to find evidence for the Castle case. We were looking into the Central Park shootings, and I guess we're getting too close.

speaker: MATT
line: Then you need to back off.

speaker: KAREN
line: No, Matt.

speaker: MATT
line: You need to back off! This is not a game, Karen. This is dangerous.

speaker: KAREN
line: Right, well, so was working at Nelson and Murdock. I— The cops have offered me protection and I'm— I'm taking it. So you don't have to worry. I'm— I'm fine. Look, I'm gonna— I'm gonna go.

speaker: MATT
line: I'm gonna come with you—

speaker: KAREN
line: No! Matt, I'm— I'm not yours to protect.

speaker: OFFICER
line: Room's been checked, it's clear. You need anything, anything at all, we'll be just outside.

speaker: KAREN
line: Okay, thanks. What I need is about 12 hours' sleep.

speaker: KAREN
line: You said you'd bring a car, not steal mine.

speaker: FRANK
line: It's a good song. We used to sing along to that. Imagine me doing that.

speaker: KAREN
line: I inherited the tapes with the car.

speaker: FRANK
line: Hey— Look, maybe you don't wanna be here, mmm?

speaker: KAREN
line: Gotta say, I'm having second thoughts. I'm not a lawyer. I'm not protected by attorney-client privilege. Lying to the cops, that makes me an accessory.

speaker: FRANK
line: Okay. So, walk away. Go.

speaker: KAREN
line: Blacksmith already tried to get me once. I really don't wanna give him a second chance.

speaker: FRANK
line: He's not gonna get it.

speaker: MARCI
line: Hello, Mr. Nelson. You decent? Oh, boo. I was hoping to catch an eyeful.

speaker: FOGGY
line: No such luck.

speaker: MARCI
line: It's a Foggy Bear. Calm down, I also brought you this.

speaker: MARCI
line: There's a, uh, lot of extra security out there. Oh. Anything going on I should know about?

speaker: FOGGY
line: Um, I don't know. I heard a hell of a lot of noise last night. You didn't see Matt on the way in, did you?

speaker: MARCI
line: Sorry. So, how are you, really?

speaker: FOGGY
line: Peachy. I'm in the hospital with a hole in my arm and Nelson-Murdock's kaput. They say it comes in threes. Next you're gonna tell me Josie's burnt down.

speaker: MARCI
line: Wouldn't be the worst thing in the world. But actually, I'm here to present you with a new opportunity. People around town have been talking about you.

speaker: FOGGY
line: About how I blew the trial of the century?

speaker: MARCI
line: Give yourself more credit. Your opening statement set the tone for the trial. Which, if Castle hadn't been such a lunatic, you might've actually won. Some are saying it was impressive.

speaker: FOGGY
line: I lost the case. My firm imploded.

speaker: MARCI
line: And now you're a free agent. You can finally be your own man. What you might consider a failure could actually be something else. A new beginning. I knew you were gonna be sensitive about this. That's what I like about you. I'm just asking if it would be okay, in the near future, for me to set up a meeting.

speaker: FOGGY
line: Where?

speaker: MARCI
line: All in time. I need to float your name first.

speaker: FOGGY
line: Float my name?

speaker: MARCI
line: Well, I might've already done that. And I got a very positive response. Just promise me you'll keep an open mind?

speaker: FOGGY
line: Okay.

speaker: MARCI
line: Okay. Good.

speaker: FRANK
line: You need something from the car?

speaker: KAREN
line: Yeah. Evidence I collected on the Blacksmith.

speaker: FRANK
line: Yeah.

speaker: KAREN
line: Some of it Ben Urich had gathered for a story he was working on when he died.

speaker: FRANK
line: Ben Urich. The reporter. Yeah, I heard about that.

speaker: KAREN
line: I think I know who killed him.

speaker: FRANK
line: Yeah?

speaker: KAREN
line: Wilson Fisk. But I can't prove it.

speaker: FRANK
line: Yeah, well, guys like that, they think they're untouchable. And maybe they are.

speaker: KAREN
line: How do you... How do you do it?

speaker: FRANK
line: What?

speaker: KAREN
line: Just keep going?

speaker: FRANK
line: One step at a time. You just gotta keep moving forward. That's all there is to it.

speaker: GAO
line: I don't believe I've had the pleasure of making your acquaintance, Mr. Castle.

speaker: FRANK
line: Madame Gao.

speaker: GAO
line: You've been busy. I admire your efficiency, though not your methods.

speaker: FRANK
line: I'm looking for the Blacksmith.

speaker: GAO
line: Why would I help you?

speaker: FRANK
line: Because he's bad for business. And as far as territories go, New York is only one of mine. I could have 100 cops here in an hour.

speaker: GAO
line: I've grown bored with tea. However, it does seem that our interests have momentarily aligned.

speaker: GAO
line: The heroin being imported by the Blacksmith is the purest I've seen. He's also ruthless. His crew has been systematically eliminating my chemists and street dealers. I can end it tonight. But I need a place to start. My sources tell me his product come in by ship.

speaker: FRANK
line: Which pier?

speaker: GAO
line: If I knew that this conversation wouldn't be necessary.

speaker: FRANK
line: That's not a lot to go on.

speaker: GAO
line: You can be sure his goods will be well-guarded by professionals clearly more capable than my own.

speaker: FRANK
line: Thanks, Madame Gao.

speaker: GAO
line: But I fear that the path you've chosen isn't going to be an easy one.

speaker: FRANK
line: Yeah, it never is.

speaker: ADMINISTRATOR
line: So?

speaker: SHIRLEY
line: So good news is, you're not fired.

speaker: CLAIRE
line: But this is strike two.

speaker: SHIRLEY
line: Um— I protected you in there. All you gotta do is keep your mouth shut, do your job, and everything will be fine.

speaker: CLAIRE
line: That's it?

speaker: SHIRLEY
line: That's it.

speaker: CLAIRE
line: They're just gonna sweep this all under the rug, aren't they?

speaker: SHIRLEY
line: What about Louisa?

speaker: SHIRLEY
line: The story is, Louisa got killed by a junkie. Got his hands on a scalpel, things got out of hand. It was very unfortunate, and could happen to any of us.

speaker: CLAIRE
line: You can't possibly be okay with this.

speaker: SHIRLEY
line: Claire— There's a body downstairs being prepped for its second autopsy! I was willing to take responsibility for what I did, take whatever punishment that they want to dole out. But pretending like it never happened?

speaker: CLAIRE
line: Shh. Come on. Those killers are still out there, and we're not gonna report that?

speaker: SHIRLEY
line: I've got no way to confirm it, but I'm pretty sure the hospital just received a major anonymous donation.

speaker: CLAIRE
line: So, now we're taking hush money?

speaker: SHIRLEY
line: Shirley, Louisa was one of us.

speaker: CLAIRE
line: I don't know about you, but I need my job.

speaker: SHIRLEY
line: Wow.

speaker: CLAIRE
line: What?

speaker: SHIRLEY
line: Really? That's how you're gonna play this? Those patients were never formally checked in, which means there are no records. The hospital cops aren't talking— and Louisa's gone. That makes it your word against the administration's. And believe me, that is a fight you cannot win. You already got two strikes.

speaker: CLAIRE
line: Yeah.

speaker: SHIRLEY
line: Wait. No, Claire! Claire, wait—

speaker: CLAIRE
line: Let's just call this strike three, shall we?

speaker: ADMINISTRATOR
line: Ms. Temple— I'm not sure exactly when this hospital became more concerned with private donations or saving our own asses. But just an FYI, it used to be a place where job number one was saving lives. I won't be any part of this. I'm out.

speaker: SHIRLEY
line: Claire.

speaker: MAN
line: Multiple shots. I got no idea where they're coming from.

speaker: KAREN
line: No.

speaker: MAN 2
line: And our outside perimeter's not gonna—

speaker: FRANK
line: You still here, chickenshit? It's just you and me now. You hiding? Huh, you afraid?

speaker: FRANK
line: Looks like you're all out. That's all you got, huh?

speaker: BLACKSMITH'S MAN
line: The cash, the shit— Just take it. Take it all.

speaker: FRANK
line: That what you think's gonna happen, huh?

speaker: BLACKSMITH'S MAN
line: Please—

speaker: FRANK
line: You think you're gonna talk your way out of this shit?

speaker: FRANK
line: I've been looking for you. You're the Blacksmith. Say it.

speaker: BLACKSMITH'S MAN
line: God, I don't wanna die!

speaker: FRANK
line: Say it. I want you to tell me. Say, "I'm the Blacksmith." Say, "I'm the Blacksmith. I killed your wife." Say it. Say, "I killed your children." You feel me?

speaker: BLACKSMITH'S MAN
line: I did it, I did it. I'm the Blacksmith. I'm the one you want. Just finish it! Finish it!

speaker: FRANK
line: That's what you want.

speaker: FRANK
line: Here it comes.

speaker: DAREDEVIL
line: Don't shoot him, Frank! Frank!

speaker: FRANK
line: Oh, for Christ's sake. Get outta here, Red.

speaker: DAREDEVIL
line: He's lying, Frank. We're here for the same reasons, all right? I want the Blacksmith just as much as you, but he's not him. I know when someone's telling the truth, Frank. He's not.

speaker: FRANK
line: Bullshit! Just get outta here!

speaker: DAREDEVIL
line: He's not the man you came for, Frank.

speaker: BLACKSMITH'S MAN
line: It's me, I swear—

speaker: FRANK
line: Are you lying to me? Are you lying to me?

speaker: DAREDEVIL
line: He's not the Blacksmith. Put the gun down.

speaker: FRANK
line: Either way...

speaker: DAREDEVIL
line: You kill him, we have nothing.

speaker: FRANK
line: ...you die.

speaker: FRANK
line: You just couldn't let it be, could you? You just couldn't let it—

speaker: DAREDEVIL
line: You kill him, we got nothing, Frank.

speaker: RADIO
line: Castle's on board. Get back to the boat now.

speaker: FRANK
line: When are you gonna learn? Mind your own goddamn business!

speaker: DAREDEVIL
line: Goddamn it, Frank. We want the same thing.

speaker: FRANK
line: That's bullshit. That's—

speaker: DAREDEVIL
line: I don't want to fight you. I don't want to fight you.

speaker: FRANK
line: You want me to take it easy?

speaker: DAREDEVIL
line: Stay down, Frank.

speaker: FRANK
line: I'm so sick of you.

speaker: FRANK
line: Get off me! Just couldn't let me have it, could you? You just couldn't let me have it. One second in peace. It was right there. You had to sweep in. You feel good about yourself? Piece of shit.

speaker: DAREDEVIL
line: Oh, come on, Frank. It wouldn't have been the truth, and you know it. I can't let you start a war for the wrong reasons.

speaker: FRANK
line: Maybe a war is what I need. Maybe I need that. These people, they took my children from me. They killed my kids! Don't you get that?

speaker: DAREDEVIL
line: Then do right by them! Help me. Work with me to find the man who gave the order.

speaker: FRANK
line: And then what, Red? We gonna— We gonna bring him in for justice? Is that what we're gonna do? Your way's bullshit, Red. It doesn't work. I need him— I need him gone. It's gotta be permanent! It's gotta be finished!

speaker: DAREDEVIL
line: I— I understand. You're right. My way isn't working. So, maybe just this once— Maybe— yeah, your way is what it's gonna take.

speaker: FRANK
line: Red, just this once? No. No, no, no, no, no, Red. That's— that's not how it works. It's just— you cross over to my side of the line— you don't get to come back from that. Not ever.

speaker: DAREDEVIL
line: I count ten. Armed.

speaker: DAREDEVIL
line: There's a lot of gunpowder below decks. Any of these guys starts shooting, this whole ship...

speaker: FRANK
line: It'll blow straight to hell.

speaker: DAREDEVIL
line: We gotta get off this boat before they open fire.

speaker: FRANK
line: You're goddamn right you do.

speaker: THUGS
line: We got him.

speaker: FRANK
line: One batch, two batch— penny and dime. Here I come. Here I come.

speaker: COLONEL SCHOONOVER
line: Been a long time, hasn't it, Frank?

speaker: FRANK
line: Kill him.

speaker: MAN
line: Just got word from Midtown.

speaker: STICK
line: Who'd she get?

speaker: MAN
line: The Frenchman.

speaker: STICK
line: Jacques screwed the pooch. What an asshole. Now Ellie's on the war path, working her way up. You know, sooner or later, she'll find you.

speaker: MAN
line: Kid's always been a doer.

speaker: STICK
line: Follow me. A guy once told me there's a power in surrender. In choosing when your time's up. But I chose. Now, that asshole's dead. I want you outta here. If there's gonna be a tomorrow for anyone— you gotta follow the plan. Go. Get me what I need.

speaker: DAREDEVIL
line: No.

speaker: BRETT
line: My God—

speaker: KAREN
line: Brett?

speaker: BRETT
line: Be careful, Karen. Cover these bodies. Castle said he was coming here? You sure?

speaker: KAREN
line: Fifteenth Squad Sergeant to Central. Pier 81 on four-one street. I need FD and ambulances forthwith, and notify Harbor to respond. And Narcotics. This could be the largest heroin seizure in years.

speaker: KAREN
line: Frank— Why?

speaker: FOGGY
line: You heading out?

speaker: CLAIRE
line: Yeah. You?

speaker: FOGGY
line: Yep.

speaker: CLAIRE
line: Clean bill? Congrats.

speaker: FOGGY
line: Yeah, I'm a regular poster boy for health. You going on a trip?

speaker: CLAIRE
line: Something like that. I just quit.

speaker: FOGGY
line: As in, your job?

speaker: CLAIRE
line: As in, our mutual friend is gonna have to get friendly with another nurse, because the next time he needs help at the hospital, I won't be here.

speaker: CLAIRE
line: They're trying to keep what happened last night quiet, like it never happened.

speaker: FOGGY
line: Oh, wow. What did happen?

speaker: CLAIRE
line: Ask your friend.

speaker: NOBU
line: I'm ready.

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: And now, it's ready.

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: Oh, you need help. Hey, hey! We need some help here!

speaker: STICK'S MAN
line: She found him. She found him.

speaker: MATT
line: What?

speaker: STICK'S MAN
line: She found Stick and she's gonna kill him.

speaker: MATT
line: Who?

speaker: STICK'S MAN
line: Elektra.

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: Hmm.

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: We need to talk.

speaker: STICK
line: I'm all ears.

speaker: STICK
line: Ellie, come here. How are your hands?

speaker: YOUNG ELEKTRA
line: They hurt.

speaker: STICK
line: It's 'cause you're bending your wrist.

speaker: STICK
line: Hmm. Make a fist. Lock your wrist. All right. This is a punch. This is a punch. This is a punch. That's shit. Lock your wrist, breathe like I taught you.

speaker: YOUNG ELEKTRA
line: There's a man watching us.

speaker: STICK
line: Forget him. He's not watching them. He's watching me. The fight is that way, girl. Go out and finish it.

speaker: CHASTE MEMBER
line: She's impressive.

speaker: STICK
line: Yeah. Where did you say you found her, again?

speaker: CHASTE MEMBER
line: Box of Cracker Jacks.

speaker: CHASTE MEMBER
line: Still needs refining. Perhaps with more discipline or different training. Left hand up, child.

speaker: STICK
line: When the war finally comes, we're gonna need real warriors.

speaker: CHASTE MEMBER
line: You were saying?

speaker: STICK
line: She's killing him!

speaker: CHASTE MEMBER
line: No shit.

speaker: STICK
line: Ellie.

speaker: STICK
line: Ellie!

speaker: STICK
line: Ellie. Ellie. Slow it down. Drop your breath. Breathe in your stomach.

speaker: STICK
line: Nice work.

speaker: YOUNG ELEKTRA
line: You told me to fight. You told me to finish it.

speaker: STICK
line: I didn't tell you to kill him. He is an asshole, but at the end of the day, he's on our side of the war. And it's wrong to kill one of ours.

speaker: YOUNG ELEKTRA
line: It didn't feel wrong.

speaker: STICK
line: Listen. Whatever it is that you got inside you— whatever it is that burns so hot, that's good. But you gotta learn to control it. You said we're going to war.

speaker: YOUNG ELEKTRA
line: We are. And there'll be a time and place for you to turn yourself loose. But right now, the last thing you want is for everybody here to be— scared shitless of you. Tame that fire or they'll tame it for you. Get me?

speaker: STICK
line: I get you.

speaker: YOUNG ELEKTRA
line: Good. 'Cause that was just a warm-up. Come on out here. Show me what you can really do.

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: That the best you can do?

speaker: STICK
line: You haven't seen my best.

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: Well, what are you waiting for? Christmas?

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: You tried to have me killed.

speaker: STICK
line: You got that right.

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: Why, Stick?

speaker: STICK
line: It's a long story.

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: Now, what do you think you're doing?

speaker: DAREDEVIL
line: You have no right here, Matthew.

speaker: STICK
line: Too little, too late, Matty. Get out or get hurt.

speaker: DAREDEVIL
line: That's not happening, Stick!

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: I'm not gonna let you kill him.

speaker: DAREDEVIL
line: Not your choice.

speaker: DAREDEVIL
line: He raised you, Elektra.

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: Then he tried to kill me!

speaker: STICK
line: I should've done it years ago.

speaker: DAREDEVIL
line: Shut up, Stick. You're just as bad as she is.

speaker: STICK
line: Not quite. I tried to housebreak her.

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: Impossible. You're just another old man jealous of his disciple. You'd rather see me dead than outgrow you. Well, guess what? When it comes to killing, I've always been better.

speaker: STICK
line: Put up or shut up.

speaker: DAREDEVIL
line: No! Put it down!

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: They're gone.

speaker: DAREDEVIL
line: Yeah. And they took Stick.

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: How do they do that?

speaker: DAREDEVIL
line: Why did you interrupt us?

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: Because you would have killed him, Elektra.

speaker: DAREDEVIL
line: Yes! Before he killed me. Is that so offensive to your precious "code"?

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: Tell me this. Why does Stick want you dead?

speaker: DAREDEVIL
line: What does it matter?

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: It matters because Stick never does anything without a reason. All right? And the Hand, they didn't kill him. They captured him, which means he knows something. And they're gonna rip him to shreds until they find out what it is.

speaker: DAREDEVIL
line: Good.

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: Unless— Unless we get there first.

speaker: DAREDEVIL
line: You want me to help you save the man who ordered my death?

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: Yes.

speaker: DAREDEVIL
line: You really do hate me.

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: No, Elektra. This isn't about you, all right? This is about Stick. I need to know why the Hand took him. And more importantly, what they're planning next.

speaker: DAREDEVIL
line: I'm done fighting his war.

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: All right, fine. Then I'm gonna go alone.

speaker: DAREDEVIL
line: You've pushed everyone out of your life and now you want to put the little you have left on protecting that broken old man?

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: That broken old man... He gave me a life when I was— When I had nothing, when I was alone. He was the one who was there for me.

speaker: DAREDEVIL
line: He abandoned you. Just when you needed him the most because that's what he does.

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: I don't care what Stick did. I'm gonna save him.
