speaker: DAREDEVIL
line: Not if I get to him first. I'm going to kill him. And if you get in my way, Matthew— I'm gonna kill you, too.

speaker: MAN 1
line: Ready?

speaker: MAN 2
line: Yeah.

speaker: MAN 1
line: All right.

speaker: WOMAN
line: Also, uh, let's— I know that the fingerprints were probably burned— But let's get some prints taken anyways.

speaker: BRETT
line: You know you can go home now, right?

speaker: KAREN
line: Uh, yeah.

speaker: BRETT
line: You don't need anything else? I have your statement. If I have any more questions, I can track you down. And don't worry— that so-called "police protection" I gave you? They're crossing guards in Yonkers now.

speaker: KAREN
line: What? No. No, no, no. Brett, really, there's— There's nothing they could do. It wasn't their fault. Frank followed me. He kidnapped me.

speaker: BRETT
line: Well, thank Christ you managed to get away. Not many people can say that about the Punisher. Seriously, go home.

speaker: BRETT
line: Get some sleep. Ambien's the real deal. Look— I know what you're thinking. Maybe Castle survived. Maybe he's still out there. He ain't.

speaker: KAREN
line: How can you be sure? You ID him yet?

speaker: BRETT
line: There's 20 burned bodies. It takes time.

speaker: KAREN
line: So there's a chance.

speaker: BRETT
line: You saw the same explosion I did. You're safe, Karen. That nightmare you've been living, it's over. Frank Castle's a dead man.

speaker: BRETT
line: Thompson!

speaker: THOMPSON
line: Huh?

speaker: BRETT
line: Get her a lift. Wherever she wants to go. Get out of here, Karen.

speaker: MATT
line: Hey. Sorry, just, uh, research. Looking for something.

speaker: FOGGY
line: I paid the electric bill through the end of the month, so enjoy it while you can.

speaker: MATT
line: And then what?

speaker: FOGGY
line: And then it'll be cold and dark.

speaker: MATT
line: It's really over, huh? Nelson and Murdock?

speaker: FOGGY
line: You told me to move on. That's what I'm doing.

speaker: MATT
line: Look, Foggy... I'm sorry I never made it to the hospital. It's been a crazy couple of days.

speaker: FOGGY
line: I heard. Marci came by, though. Some of the higher-ups at her firm were impressed with my opening argument in the Castle case.

speaker: MATT
line: Yeah, I'm not surprised.

speaker: FOGGY
line: Neither am I. Not anymore. Castle case was in many ways a disaster, but it made me realize— I'm really good at my job.

speaker: MATT
line: Nelson and Murdock was never just your job. It was you. You're there for every client who comes through the door. Rich, poor— doesn't matter. You're the heart of this place.

speaker: FOGGY
line: You gonna try to convince me it's worth another shot?

speaker: MATT
line: No.

speaker: FOGGY
line: Oh, hey, look, I'm— I'm done here anyway. So you stay. I'll go.

speaker: MATT
line: What are you looking for?

speaker: FOGGY
line: You really wanna know?

speaker: MATT
line: Sure.

speaker: FOGGY
line: Well, there's this group that I've been following. They move through the city, and then they just— disappear. Like magic. The last place I had a fix on them was 49th and 10th. Then they were gone. I thought maybe they might be using the subway tunnels.

speaker: MATT
line: Only if they're idiots. Subway tunnels are heavily patrolled and dangerous as shit. My grandfather used to tell me stories about abandoned railway tunnels.

speaker: FOGGY
line: Abandoned? Why?

speaker: MATT
line: They kept caving in. Cost a ton. The city just finally threw in the towel— Gated them up. Best thing to ever happen to bootleggers like Grandpa. Said he could go for miles without seeing daylight. Whoever this group is— forget magic. Look for manhole covers.

speaker: FOGGY
line: Yeah, that's— Thank you, Foggy. That's really good work. Thank you.

speaker: MATT
line: That's what I do.

speaker: FOGGY
line: Hey, you, uh—

speaker: MATT
line: What?

speaker: FOGGY
line: Did you want me to convince you?

speaker: MATT
line: Of what?

speaker: FOGGY
line: This. Us. You know, giving Nelson and Murdock another shot?

speaker: MATT
line: I was hoping you would. Relieved when you didn't. Last step was us both admitting it. Now we're done.

speaker: NOBU
line: Hey.

speaker: NOBU
line: Is he close?

speaker: HIROCHI
line: Perhaps. It does not matter. We will continue until he breaks.

speaker: STICK
line: Only thing gonna crack tonight is your skull— asshole!

speaker: DAREDEVIL
line: You okay?

speaker: STICK
line: I've been better.

speaker: DAREDEVIL
line: Come on.

speaker: STICK
line: You did good, kid. You did good.

speaker: DAREDEVIL
line: No, I just— I just did what you taught me, Stick.

speaker: STICK
line: Matty, I'm proud of you.

speaker: DAREDEVIL
line: Come on, old man. Let's get you out of here.

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: Hello, boys.

speaker: DAREDEVIL
line: Do you remember when we met— you told me you'd never abandon me? It's funny. For the life of me— I can't remember being so naive I'd believe you. But I did. And now here we are.

speaker: STICK
line: Elektra.

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: Don't be a bore, Matthew. Why don't you scurry out of here and let me finish what I came to do?

speaker: DAREDEVIL
line: I told you, I'm not gonna let you kill him.

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: And I told you, too bad.

speaker: STICK
line: You let her track you.

speaker: DAREDEVIL
line: She's not gonna hurt you, Stick.

speaker: STICK
line: You have no idea what you're talking about.

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: Look at that. After all you've done, you're still a disappointment to Daddy.

speaker: DAREDEVIL
line: I'm getting him out of here.

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: He's not going anywhere.

speaker: STICK
line: Neither are you, child. They got you right where they want you.

speaker: NOBU
line: It's painful, raising children. We spend our lives teaching them to be strong, to be independent. Not realizing that once we have achieved that— they are no longer in our control.

speaker: DAREDEVIL
line: Nobu.

speaker: NOBU
line: Tell them. Tell them why we're all here tonight. You— the loyal one— and it.

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: I'm sorry about before. I should've stopped, but—

speaker: STAR
line: Did you really think you could get away with bringing it here? Your kid attacked her. You've endangered all of us. You know what they'll do to you when they find out?

speaker: STICK
line: There are larger pieces at play here.

speaker: STAR
line: Oh, you're out of your mind. You know what it is, what it can do.

speaker: STICK
line: Stop.

speaker: STAR
line: You've gone soft for that thing, Stick. If you won't kill it— I will.

speaker: STICK
line: Just stop. You're right. She's my responsibility. I'll take care of her.

speaker: STICK
line: Gotta go.

speaker: DAREDEVIL
line: Nobu, you let these two go and you can have me.

speaker: NOBU
line: I need it.

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: Call me "it" again and I'll cut you in half.

speaker: NOBU
line: You are right, Elektra. You're not a girl anymore. But now, seeing you fight, seeing you with the man who saved your life— I'd know you anywhere.

speaker: DAREDEVIL
line: Do you know who we are?

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: You call yourselves the Hand.

speaker: NOBU
line: Do you know who we serve?

speaker: STICK
line: Yeah. Some mythical piece of shit called the Black Sky.

speaker: DAREDEVIL
line: What is this?

speaker: STICK
line: The end of the war you don't believe in. We just lost.

speaker: NOBU
line: The Black Sky is not a myth. We have wanted you since you were a child. You were taken from us— but now you have returned.

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: What the hell are you talking about?

speaker: NOBU
line: It's you, Elektra. You are the Black Sky. Our greatest living weapon.

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: No.

speaker: DAREDEVIL
line: Elektra, do not listen to him, all right? It's a trick. It's another illusion, another game. He wants something from you.

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: He told me I was out of control.

speaker: DAREDEVIL
line: They don't get to tell you what you are.

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: But you said the same thing.

speaker: DAREDEVIL
line: Well, I was wrong. No one gets to tell you.

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: But it makes sense, right?

speaker: DAREDEVIL
line: No.

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: Only if you let it.

speaker: DAREDEVIL
line: It explains everything.

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: You knew all along.

speaker: STICK
line: Yeah, I did.

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: That's why they hated me. That's why everyone eventually does.

speaker: DAREDEVIL
line: Elektra, you still have a choice. The woman I know is still in there.

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: Is she?

speaker: NOBU
line: You are home now. We live and die to serve you, Black Sky.

speaker: DAREDEVIL
line: No, Jesus. Elektra.

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: If what they say is true— I studied it, as a child, with the Chaste. I committed it to memory, so I could fight it one day. But there's no fight anymore. The Black Sky is destiny.

speaker: DAREDEVIL
line: No. Elektra. Elektra.

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: Leave me.

speaker: DAREDEVIL
line: I'm not gonna leave you, I...

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: Leave!

speaker: YOUNG ELEKTRA
line: Why are they taking so long?

speaker: STICK
line: This Ambassador and his wife, the only thing they can't have is a little girl of their own. Now, they'll have you.

speaker: YOUNG ELEKTRA
line: They'll never have me.

speaker: STICK
line: Kid, use your head. Watch these people. Watch everything about 'em. How they walk, how they talk, how they eat. All of it. Playing someone else, someone fancy— that's a good skill to have in your pocket.

speaker: YOUNG ELEKTRA
line: Why can't I stay with you?

speaker: STICK
line: 'Cause we'll be hunted the rest of our lives.

speaker: YOUNG ELEKTRA
line: We can take them.

speaker: STICK
line: Ellie— I haven't told you everything, but someday, someone will come for you. And everything will change. I'm gonna make that as far off as possible.

speaker: YOUNG ELEKTRA
line: You'll train someone else. I know you will. You... You'll forget about me.

speaker: STICK
line: Forget my Ellie?

speaker: STICK
line: Never.

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: I pretended my whole life. I tried. I tried to control this inside me. Maybe I don't have to anymore. Maybe this is my chance.

speaker: DAREDEVIL
line: To what? To be loved?

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: Yes.

speaker: DAREDEVIL
line: Then don't let me get in your way. I am the enemy of the Hand. So kill me.

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: It's too late. Let me go.

speaker: DAREDEVIL
line: Now— you could either try and kill us, and prove them right. Or you could save Stick and prove them wrong.

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: You never know when to give up, do you?

speaker: DAREDEVIL
line: No. And neither does he.

speaker: KAREN
line: Ahh!

speaker: KAREN
line: Frank.

speaker: SCHOONOVER
line: You should be at the bottom of the Hudson. Losing $100 million in heroin would've been worth it to take you down. But here we are, huh?

speaker: SCHOONOVER
line: You could've been part of it, like Gosnell. You could've been rich. And maybe you could've taken your family to the Bahamas instead of Central Park, huh?

speaker: FRANK
line: You think this— all of this— is about a bad drug deal?

speaker: SCHOONOVER
line: That's what you see. You're losing your touch, Frank. Your kids, at the park? Nah. Who cares? That's never what this has been about. It's about what happened with you. With all of us. Kandahar.

speaker: SCHOONOVER
line: You think they would ever let that go?

speaker: KAREN
line: Frank, stop.

speaker: KAREN
line: You don't have to kill him.

speaker: FRANK
line: Go back to the car.

speaker: KAREN
line: What's he talking about? Kandahar, what's that— What happened?

speaker: FRANK
line: Go.

speaker: KAREN
line: Did you do something? If they come after you— Just tell me. Tell me the truth. I'll help you. I'll help you figure it out. Just tell me the truth.

speaker: SCHOONOVER
line: Yeah. Tell her the truth. Tell me for Maria. Tell me for Lisa. Tell me for Frank, Jr. Tell her what you did.

speaker: FRANK
line: You shut up!

speaker: SCHOONOVER
line: Tell her.

speaker: KAREN
line: What happened? Please, we'll figure it out, but if you kill him, you will never know.

speaker: KAREN
line: No, no, no. Frank! Listen to me. Frank! You do this, and you are the monster that they say you are. Do you hear me?

speaker: KAREN
line: You do this, and I am done. That's it. You're dead to me. Do you hear me?

speaker: FRANK
line: I'm already dead.

speaker: SCHOONOVER
line: It's like a candy store in here. Go ahead. Go ahead. I had to teach you how to hold a gun. You remember? Eighteen, and you'd never held a piece before. Come on. They call you "the Punisher." Prove it. Prove you don't need me anymore. One shot— one kill. You taught me that.

speaker: FRANK
line: You stupid son of a—

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: Come on. Come on.

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: Still want to kill me?

speaker: STICK
line: Yeah. But he'd be pissed.

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: I just saved your ass and you're worried about what he thinks?

speaker: STICK
line: Matt didn't come to rescue me. He came to save you.

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: I don't need to be saved.

speaker: STICK
line: From yourself, girl. He knew that killing me would've been your point of no return, so he stopped you. He thinks you're worth saving.

speaker: STICK
line: Earn that.

speaker: NOBU
line: It will be ours. You cannot stop what we've started.

speaker: DAREDEVIL
line: Watch me.

speaker: NOBU
line: Daredevil must die.

speaker: HAND MEMBER
line: Master Nobu. The necessary preparations have been made. It's ready for use, should it come to that. And as per your orders, we just obtained these. Twenty targets in total, all in New York City.

speaker: NOBU
line: After years of searching— the fate of Black Sky is in our hands. Now this Daredevil is the only thing that stands in our way. I suggest you get to work.

speaker: HAND MEMBER
line: Which one would you like to hit?

speaker: NOBU
line: All of them.

speaker: MATT
line: We need to lay low. They're gonna come for us.

speaker: STICK
line: Bullshit. They'll come for her. What is this?

speaker: MATT
line: I'm sorry, old man, but I just can't take chances with you anymore.

speaker: STICK
line: You're naive. She should be tied in this chair, not me.

speaker: MATT
line: She is not the problem. They are.

speaker: STICK
line: They're gonna turn this city upside down looking for her, Matty. They'll watch it burn.

speaker: MATT
line: That's why I said we need to work together.

speaker: STICK
line: There is no together. All these years, I tried to tame her. I should have let her bleed out in the back of that car.

speaker: MATT
line: You should have some damn gratitude. She spared your life.

speaker: STICK
line: The Black Sky cannot be controlled, manipulated or transported. It must be extinguished at all costs.

speaker: MATT
line: You wanna talk about being naive? 'Cause right now you're tied to a chair spouting rhetoric about an ancient war.

speaker: STICK
line: Do you even have a plan?

speaker: MATT
line: I'm working on it.

speaker: STICK
line: Well, while you're working on it, son, do me a favor and pull your head out of your ass. The Black Sky—

speaker: MATT
line: The Black Sky is bullshit, Stick. It's a myth. No one believes it but you.

speaker: STICK
line: Every assassin in the Hand believes it. What do you think they're gonna do about it?

speaker: MATT
line: What about what I believe, Stick? What about what I'm gonna do about it?

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: Leave me alone, Matthew.

speaker: MATT
line: Stick's downstairs. He's restrained. You know, whatever you're feeling, it's gonna pass.

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: What do you know about what I'm feeling?

speaker: MATT
line: Just consider the possibility that there is no such thing as a Black Sky. That it's— it's mysticism, you know? It's nonsense.

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: I've been trained to kill it since I was a kid.

speaker: MATT
line: Yeah, maybe everything they taught you was a lie.

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: Stick says I have a gift. The special kind, the kind very few people have—

speaker: MATT
line: "The kind very few people have or deserve." I know. I got the same speech. Stick likes his fortune-cookie wisdom, but that's all he needed, 'cause he was training children to fight a war.

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: You can't deny it. Some of what the Hand does defies explanation.

speaker: MATT
line: Just because I don't understand something doesn't mean I'm ready to chalk it up as some fairy tale.

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: True or not— the legend says that once they have the Black Sky they'll be capable of anything. It's not about what I'm willing to do. Even in a cage I'll be their false idol. They'll do terrible things in my name because they think the Black Sky will make them invincible.

speaker: MATT
line: Well, they can't have you. You don't belong to anyone. And you may be smarter and stronger and more powerful than anyone they've ever met— but like I keep saying, they don't get to tell you who you are.

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: Their organization is older than most countries. They're powerful and they're everywhere.

speaker: MATT
line: And they survived— just like the Chaste— by staying in the shadows— by getting people to believe wholeheartedly in their legend. But if we shine a light on them, they'll scatter— all right? We can take them down. Not Stick's way. We can do it our way.

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: You would trust me after all I've put you through?

speaker: MATT
line: The Hand's ninjas can mask their heartbeats... Yours is always loud and clear.

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: I've been fighting this war my whole life. I've heard every story. Some people say Nobu's lived three lifetimes. A criminal record that goes back decades. True or not, he's the head of the snake. But he's our best chance of taking down the Hand.

speaker: MATT
line: Then our job is simple. We find Nobu. We extract him. We remove him from the Hand without alerting his troops.

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: Can't be that easy.

speaker: MATT
line: Giving up is easy.

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: You will kill him?

speaker: MATT
line: No. That would make him a martyr. I wanna dethrone him. Defrock him and let him rot in a cell. Show this cult of his that their holy man isn't anything but a guy.

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: We'll have to find him first.

speaker: MATT
line: Yeah. And I say we head straight into the lion's den. The last thing they're expecting is that we hit back at them now.

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: You would risk everything for me?

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: So how do we do this?

speaker: MATT

line: You think outside of the box, and that is exactly what we're looking for. If the past few months are any indication, my firm is going to need a very resourceful attorney. Someone like you who's not afraid to take on riskier, non-traditional cases.

line: They're not stopping!

line: Where are they? The people on your list.

speaker: DAREDEVIL
line: What do you want?

speaker: ELEKTRA

speaker: NOBU
line: We shall see.

line: Wait, wait. Wait for one second. One second. So, what if— What if from now on, if— if we make it— wherever you run, I— I run with you?

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: You're not serious.

speaker: DAREDEVIL
line: I've never been more serious.

speaker: MATT
line: This, Elektra, this is a part of me that I need. And you're the only one who gets it. Without this, I'm not alive. I'm not. Not really. And I know that now, thanks to you. speaker: ELEKTRA
line: You hide from yourself. You don't let anyone in.

speaker: MATT
line: You. I let you in. Think about it. What if this isn't the end? What if it's just the beginning?

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: No. They'll find us.

speaker: MATT
line: No, we'll keep moving. We'll change identities. We'll, we'll hide. They'll never catch us. What do you say?

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: Uh, I say let's go to London. Yeah? Madrid. Tunisia. There are sexy places to hide.

speaker: MATT
line: Hey, I've never been further north than 116th Street, so...

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: Because you love New York.

speaker: MATT
line: And I'd give my life for it, but there's one thing in this world that makes me feel more alive. And that's you.

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: I'm the Black Sky, Matthew.

speaker: MATT
line: Yeah, and I'm the Devil of Hell's Kitchen.

speaker: MATT
line: The airport's just a cab fare away. All we gotta do is survive whatever's waiting for us behind that door.

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: Let's get out of here.

speaker: DAREDEVIL
line: Remember— they're trying to kill me, not you.

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: Over my dead body.

speaker: NOBU
line: No one escapes destiny. You belong to us. And you belong in the ground.

speaker: DAREDEVIL
line: You're done, Nobu. Your army will crumble. And you will leave my city alone.

speaker: NOBU
line: Your city belongs to no one. And she belongs to us!

speaker: DAREDEVIL
line: No. No, Elektra.

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: They have nothing now. I took it all away.

speaker: DAREDEVIL
line: It's okay. It's okay. Try not to talk.

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: I know— I know now what it feels to be good.

speaker: DAREDEVIL
line: Just relax. Try not to— try not to talk.

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: Does it always hurt that much?

speaker: DAREDEVIL
line: Yeah. Yeah, it, uh— it always hurts that much.

speaker: ELEKTRA
line: This is not the end.

speaker: NOBU
line: Finish him.

speaker: POLICE
line: Get down. Get down. Don't move! Everybody get down!

speaker: KAREN
line: Frank.

speaker: PUNISHER
line: See you around, Red.

speaker: STICK
line: And this time, you piece of shit...

speaker: STICK
line: ...stay down.

speaker: MATT
line: I wanted to say a few words, but I don't have any.

speaker: STICK
line: God rest her soul. That should be enough.

speaker: MATT
line: You know, once in college, I brought her roses. She hates roses. You wanted her dead.

speaker: STICK
line: Was it worth it?

speaker: MATT
line: What?

speaker: STICK
line: Loving her.

speaker: MATT
line: You taught me to cut all my ties to humanity— to other people. I had only a few moments with her amidst all the noise, chaos, and the violence. We were together only for moments. That was all. Orchids. She likes orchids. And, yeah, Stick— it was worth it.

speaker: STICK
line: Matt, you are the toughest son of a bitch I have ever met. Let's go home.

speaker: FOGGY
line: Are you gonna be okay?

speaker: KAREN
line: I came to New York thinking there's no way I could feel lonely in a city of millions.

speaker: FOGGY
line: But you do.

speaker: KAREN
line: Somehow it makes it all worse. I used to love coming here with you and Matt. Josie's actually felt like home.

speaker: FOGGY
line: A home with very sticky floors and belligerent drunks, nightly.

speaker: KAREN
line: Right. And now, no Matt.

speaker: FOGGY
line: No us. No Nelson, Murdock, Page. We may not be working together anymore— but you're not alone, Karen. I'm still your friend if you'll let me be.

speaker: KAREN
line: Yeah, you're not getting out that easy, Nelson. You are stuck with me.

speaker: FOGGY
line: Wouldn't have it any other way. You're gonna be all right. More than all right. You're gonna come out on top.

speaker: KAREN
line: Thanks. How about you? Big job, hotshot, corner office lawyer man.

speaker: FOGGY
line: It could be exciting.

speaker: KAREN
line: Yeah, you could be rich.

speaker: FOGGY
line: Yeah, rich enough to stop drinking the rotgut swill they serve here. Hey, Josie. About that long-running Nelson-Murdock tab...

speaker: JOSIE
line: Yeah, yeah, I'll add it on.

speaker: FOGGY
line: No. We're, uh— we're gonna settle up. Close us out, Josie. We're done here.

speaker: ELLISON
line: Karen Page, what the hell are you still doing here? It's Christmas Eve. Shouldn't you be home celebrating with all that family that you can't stand, like everybody else? Oh, no, I'm sorry. I must be projecting.

speaker: KAREN
line: I, uh— can't seem to stop staring at a blank screen.

speaker: ELLISON
line: Writer's block.

speaker: KAREN
line: Mmm.

speaker: ELLISON
line: There's a cure. Scotch.

speaker: KAREN
line: That helps you write?

speaker: ELLISON
line: Wow! No. No, it just helps me not care so much.

speaker: KAREN
line: Yeah, well, that's definitely my problem. I care, probably too much, about all of it. I don't even know if I should start with the hostage crisis, or Frank, or vigilante justice...

speaker: ELLISON
line: That's just— that's just garbage.

speaker: KAREN
line: Well, it's news.

speaker: ELLISON
line: No, it's not. Not anymore. I mean, all the facts about that have been reported already. Look. If you— if you really wanna torture yourself this holiday, go ahead, be my guest. But at least write something new. Something different. Something that only you can write.

speaker: KAREN
line: Right. Which— which would be what?

speaker: ELLISON
line: The truth. Your truth, Karen. All of it. Everything that you've been through. Don't pull any punches. This is New York. People think that they've seen everything. Prove 'em wrong. Tell them something they don't know. Hell, I'd read the shit out of that.

speaker: ELLISON
line: Happy Hanukkah.

speaker: KAREN
line: Scotch.

speaker: ELLISON
line: Mmm, you know, just— just in case. I'll expect 2,000 words in my inbox before Santa shows up.

speaker: KAREN
line: You got it, boss.

speaker: KAREN
line: Okay.

speaker: KAREN (V.O.)
line: "What is it, to be a hero? Look in the mirror and you'll know. Look into your own eyes and tell me you are not heroic... that you have not endured, or suffered or lost the things you care about most. And yet, here you are— a survivor of Hell's Kitchen— the hottest place anyone's ever known. A place where cowards don't last long. So you must be a hero. We all are. Some more than others, but none of us alone. Some bloody their fists trying to keep the Kitchen safe. Others bloody the streets in the hope they can stop the tide, the crime, the cruelty— the disregard for human life all around them. But this is Hell's Kitchen. Angel or devil, rich or poor, young or old, you live here. You didn't choose this town. It chose you. Because a hero isn't someone who lives above us, keeping us safe. A hero is not a god or an idea. A hero lives here— on the street, among us, with us. Always here but rarely recognized. Look in the mirror and see yourself for what you truly are. You're a New Yorker. You're a hero. This is your Hell's Kitchen. Welcome home."

line: Holy shit.

line: Tom McGuinness, 455 Lovell Ave.

line: At this time, the grand jury has elected not to indict Wilson Fisk, but this office, under my leadership, will pursue every lead, every piece of evidence that leads us to uncovering the truth, wherever we may find it.

line: Is he?

speaker: FISK

line: My hands were never clean. If you truly want me... share your life with me. Fully.

speaker: FISK

line: Oh.

speaker: MATT
line: What is Fisk planning?

line: Planning?

line: What Fisk will do to me is infinitely worse...

line: Things are about to get very bad for you.

speaker: MATT
line: What is Fisk planning?

line: Do you mind if I come in?

line: Marriage?

line: He's been planning the ceremony for months. He's gonna charm the press and the public and make Hell's Kitchen love him again.

speaker: VANESSA
line: Do I look that nervous?

speaker: FISK
line: Yes, a little, but it's charming.

speaker: FISK
line: I never knew that I could feel this way until the day that we met. I didn't think that I was capable, that there would be someone... that I would care for more than my own life. speaker: VANESSA
line: Don't you understand we're all broken? The point is to find the person whose broken pieces fit with yours.

speaker: MATT
line: You're gonna tell me everything. I wanna know where everyone is gonna be. Anyone who could stop me.

speaker: MANNING
line: Stop you?

speaker: MATT
line: From killing Fisk.

speaker: MANNING
line: He controls all of the FBI agents who are guarding him. The hotel is a fortress.

speaker: MATT
line: Is that a no?

speaker: MANNING
line: You'll never get to him.

speaker: MATT
line: Sounds like a no.

speaker: MANNING
line: I can give you something better!

speaker: MATT
line: I'm listening.

speaker: MANNING
line: I witnessed Ms. Marianna order the murder of Agent Nadeem. And Fisk ordered many. Agent Winn. Julie Barnes! I could testify!

speaker: MATT
line: I know about Winn and Nadeem. Who's Julie Barnes?

speaker: MANNING
line: The rose. I think.

line: Tell me again how you ended up dangling off a building?

speaker: MANNING
line: I tripped.

speaker: BRETT
line: Get him out of here.

speaker: FOGGY
line: I thought "ambulance chaser" was a figure of speech.

speaker: BRETT
line: Not one of your best burns, Detective.

speaker: FOGGY
line: I'm not in the mood to be clever today.

speaker: BRETT
line: Yeah, me neither. We had him, Foggy. We were this goddamn close.

speaker: FOGGY
line: I know.

speaker: BRETT
line: Instead of locking up that bald asshole, I had to tell Mrs. Nadeem she'd never see her husband again.

speaker: FOGGY
line: How did that happen?

speaker: BRETT
line: I don't know.

line: Listen. Something's been brought to my attention. As an officer of the court, I'm compelled to report it. I have reason to believe that someone's gonna try to murder Wilson Fisk today.

speaker: BRETT
line: Someone, huh? About what time is this going down? I wanna have some popcorn ready.

speaker: FOGGY
line: Need I remind you of your obligation to protect and serve?

line: Stick your obligation up your ass, Nelson. If Fisk disappears, all his bullshit goes with him.

speaker: FOGGY
line: And the FBI agents on his payroll just fold back into the mix. Including the one who shot Ray.

speaker: BRETT
line: Don't think of it as protecting Fisk. Think of it as protecting the case we can build against the shitbags who helped him. Once we get them, they'll turn faster than old milk.

speaker: FOGGY
line: Still, with Fisk gone, we'll get 'em eventually.

speaker: BRETT
line: Brett, please. This certain someone we're talking about... he's angry. But I know he'll do the right thing if I can just slow him down. Give him time to think.

speaker: FOGGY
line: I'll beef up the perimeter around the hotel. But I'm sending in my C team.

speaker: BRETT
line: Thank you.

speaker: FOGGY
line: I'm talking rookies and retirees.

line: After the body of Supervisory Special Agent Winn was found in the Hudson, search divers also recovered the murder weapon. The registered service sidearm of fellow FBI agent Ray Nadeem. speaker: FOGGY
line: Press is calling me a liar. FBI is calling Ray mentally unstable.

line: Ray's grand jury testimony is sealed, so Fisk is just throwing up smokescreens until people forget and move on.

line: Yeah? Well, unless Matt figures out some way to stop him, he's going to get away with it. With all of it.

line: You mean unless Matt kills him.

line: Shouldn't have warned Mahoney.

line: If the police have Fisk surrounded, maybe Matt won't be able to go through with it.

line: Or maybe he'll get arrested. Or worse.

line: Karen...

speaker: FOGGY
line: Look, I'm not saying that I want him to kill Fisk. I don't want that.

line: What if it's the only way?

line: It's, uh... It's not murder if it's self-defense, right?

line: Technically, plotting to kill someone is the exact legal opposite of self-defense.

speaker: FOGGY
line: You know what I mean.

line: I get it. Our best shot at taking down Fisk died with Nadeem. But yesterday was also a good day...

speaker: FOGGY
line: ...because Matt came back to us. The real Matt.

speaker: KAREN
line: Yeah, for, like, a minute maybe.

line: Eventually, he'll come to his senses. Matt's Matt because he believes that everyone deserves a shot at redemption.

speaker: KAREN
line: Except Fisk.

speaker: FOGGY
line: Everyone. It's a Catholic thing. That's why he doesn't kill people. If he crosses that line... Matt will never be able to forgive himself. And being around us will just remind him of who he was and what he's done.

line: Yeah, we'd really lose him, wouldn't we?

line: Hello? Yes. Can I ask why? Uh, no need. I know where you are.

line: What? What is it?

line: It's Fisk.

line: I have a life. I'm not prepared to become a wanted fugitive.

speaker: FOGGY
line: Wait, wait, wait. No, just wait. What if it's a trap and you don't walk out again? Huh?

line: Can you run that downstairs?

line: Mr. Nelson.

line: Special Agent Poindexter.

line: You just won me 50 bucks. Some of the guys were betting you wouldn't show.

speaker: FOGGY
line: I'm always available to help the FBI, Agent Poindexter. In fact... please smile.

speaker: FOGGY
line: There. Posted to my campaign web page and the tens of thousands of police officers that know that I'm here. With you. Helping.

line: Relax, Mr. Nelson. You're not in any danger. You'll be very useful when you're the next district attorney.

line: Why am I here?

line: 'Cause Ray Nadeem was a friend of yours.

speaker: FOGGY
line: A client.

speaker: DEX
line: Sad, the way it all turned out.

speaker: FOGGY
line: Even though he's dead, I can't answer any questions that would violate privilege.

speaker: DEX
line: I'm not asking you to. Follow me.

speaker: DEX
line: Thank you for coming, Mr. Nelson.

line: Mrs. Nadeem. What are you doing here?

line: I came to apologize.

line: To apologize?

line: I asked them to call you, because you were Ray's lawyer. And I want to fully cooperate with the investigation of my husband.

speaker: SEEMA
line: What Ray did is... How could a man I loved with all my heart... the father of my son, turn out to be such a monster?

line: It wasn't your fault, Seema. Ray fooled a lot of people. Nobody here blames you or Sami. You're still part of the FBI family.

line: We'll give you the room. Take all the time you need.

line: Suck it up. I'm only doing this because I have to.

line: How's Sami?

line: He's okay. With my sister. I haven't told him yet.

line: When did you get here?

line: I came as soon as I saw the news. I didn't want to believe it, but I know I needed to hear the truth.

speaker: FOGGY
line: I'm so sorry. That... must have been an incredible shock.

speaker: SEEMA
line: It was. But I decided it was the right thing for me to come in and to cooperate.

line: That was smart. Totally the right thing to do.

speaker: SEEMA
line: I was hoping you could help me figure out how I can help the FBI. And whether or not Ray's life insurance policy will still pay. Otherwise, Sami and I have nothing to live on. How will we survive?

line: I'll do everything I can.

speaker: SEEMA

line: Wilson?

line: Are you ready?

line: You killed innocent people.

line: You killed Julie.

line: She betrayed me! Just like everyone!

line: Do you, Wilson Fisk, take Vanessa Marianna to be your lawfully wedded wife?

line: I do.

line: I'm gonna kill you, Fisk.

line: Do it. But I'll never stop coming for those you love.

line: I'm not. She's as guilty as I am. More. So if you kill me, you have to kill her. And then you have to kill the next person, and the next. Where does it end, Matthew?

line: Do it. Kill us both. I'd rather die with him than live in a world without him.

line: I'm not gonna kill you, Fisk. But you're going back to prison.

line: On what charges?

line: Vanessa goes free. Completely. No charges, no investigation, nothing. Ever.

line: And in return?

line: You go back to prison. You serve your time. All of it. And you leave Vanessa free.

line: Wilson, no.

line: And if I keep my word?

speaker: MATT
line: Then you leave my wife alone. You leave Vanessa free!

line: If you keep your word. Then, it's a deal.

line: Wilson Fisk, you are under arrest.

line: Did you give one to Ray Nadeem?

speaker: FISK
line: Please!

line: Please!

line: Matt should be here.

speaker: MATT
line: Last time we spoke, I confronted Father Lantom. I was angry. I'd change that if I could.

speaker: MAGGIE
line: If God allowed that, there'd be no future. Just people endlessly rewriting the past.

speaker: MATT
line: Yeah. I think he was trying to tell me that for a long time. His last words were, "Forgive us." Do you think that's possible?

speaker: MAGGIE
line: He told me something, years ago, when this happened, that I never forgot. See, I was pretty angry at God and bitter towards his world. How could a loving God blind me? Why? Anyway, he told me... God's plan is like a beautiful tapestry. And the tragedy of being human is that we only get to see it from the back. With all the ragged threads and the muddy colors. And we only get a hint at the true beauty that would be revealed if we could see the whole pattern on the other side... as God does.

speaker: MATT
line: Anyway, I've been thinking a lot about it recently, 'cause... I realize I've made some bad choices and hurt people that I love without meaning to.

speaker: MAGGIE
line: You don't always know when you start down a false path.

speaker: MATT
line: No, you don't. And that's my point. I realize that if my life had turned out any differently, that I would never have become Daredevil. And although people have died on my watch, people who shouldn't have, there are countless others that have lived. So, maybe it is all part of God's plan. Maybe my life has been exactly as it had to be.

speaker: MAGGIE
line: You have a generous heart, Matthew.

speaker: MAGGIE
line: To see the good in so much pain.

speaker: MATT
line: Not always. In fact, Father Lantom used to help me with that. Help me see the errors of my ways. I could use someone else to help me with that now... once in a while.

speaker: MAGGIE
line: I'm a nun, Matthew. Helping is what I was called to do.

speaker: MATT
line: Feels like half of Hell's Kitchen is here today to say goodbye to Father Paul Lantom. Seems fair. He certainly welcomed everyone here, Catholic or not. And he expected those of us who were to, uh, look for ways to do good in our community. Not even the kids got out of that requirement. I'm sure I'm not the only one who remembers his "suggestion" that we give some of our First Communion money to the poor box.

speaker: MATT
line: And that was his way. To think of the community, and the, uh... and the individuals in it. To think in terms of, "What can I give?" He gave his life, right here in this church, protecting others. Standing up to a man who used fear as a tool to set neighbors against one another. If Father Lantom had an enemy, I would say it was fear. For me, personally, he spent many years trying to get me to face my own fears. To understand how they enslaved me, how they divided me from the people that I love. He counseled me to transcend my fears, to be brave enough to forgive... and see the possibilities of being a man without fear. That was his legacy. And now it's up to all of us to, uh, live up to it.

speaker: KAREN
line: That was nice, what you said.

speaker: MATT
line: Yeah, it wasn't just him, you know. It was you, too. You helped me see the truth about myself.

speaker: KAREN
line: Ouch. That had to hurt.

speaker: MATT
line: Well, maybe one of these days, I'll forgive you, too.

speaker: KAREN
line: Before my funeral, I hope.

speaker: MATT
line: I'm glad you told me, Karen. About Wesley and your brother.
